yonatangross/orchestkit/content-type-rec.title: content-type-recipes
yonatangross/orchestkit/content-type-rec.description: Step-by-step recipes for demo videos. Use when creating skill demos, agent showcases, plugin installs, or tutorial walkthroughs with precise timing
yonatangross/orchestkit/content-type-rec.descriptionEn: Step-by-step recipes for demo videos. Use when creating skill demos, agent showcases, plugin installs, or tutorial walkthroughs with precise timing
yonatangross/orchestkit/content-type-rec.descriptionCn: 演示视频的分步食谱。在精确计时创建技能演示、代理展示、插件安装或教程演练时使用

yonatangross/orchestkit/context-compress.title: context-compression
yonatangross/orchestkit/context-compress.description: Use when conversation context is too long, hitting token limits, or responses are degrading. Compresses history while preserving critical information using anchored summarization and probe-based validation.
yonatangross/orchestkit/context-compress.descriptionEn: Use when conversation context is too long, hitting token limits, or responses are degrading. Compresses history while preserving critical information using anchored summarization and probe-based validation.
yonatangross/orchestkit/context-compress.descriptionCn: 当对话上下文太长、达到令牌限制或响应质量下降时使用。使用锚定摘要和基于探测的验证来压缩历史记录，同时保留关键信息。

yonatangross/orchestkit/context-engineer.title: context-engineering
yonatangross/orchestkit/context-engineer.description: Use when designing agent system prompts, optimizing RAG retrieval, or when context is too expensive or slow. Reduces tokens while maintaining quality through strategic positioning and attention-aware design.
yonatangross/orchestkit/context-engineer.descriptionEn: Use when designing agent system prompts, optimizing RAG retrieval, or when context is too expensive or slow. Reduces tokens while maintaining quality through strategic positioning and attention-aware design.
yonatangross/orchestkit/context-engineer.descriptionCn: 在设计代理系统提示、优化 RAG 检索或上下文过于昂贵或缓慢时使用。通过战略定位和注意力感知设计，减少代币，同时保持质量。

yonatangross/orchestkit/contextual-retri.title: contextual-retrieval
yonatangross/orchestkit/contextual-retri.description: Anthropic's Contextual Retrieval technique for improved RAG. Use when chunks lose context during retrieval, implementing hybrid BM25+vector search, or reducing retrieval failures.
yonatangross/orchestkit/contextual-retri.descriptionEn: Anthropic's Contextual Retrieval technique for improved RAG. Use when chunks lose context during retrieval, implementing hybrid BM25+vector search, or reducing retrieval failures.
yonatangross/orchestkit/contextual-retri.descriptionCn: Anthropic 的上下文检索技术可改进 RAG。当块在检索过程中丢失上下文时使用，实现混合 BM25+向量搜索，或减少检索失败。

yonatangross/orchestkit/contract-testing.title: contract-testing
yonatangross/orchestkit/contract-testing.description: Consumer-driven contract testing with Pact for API compatibility. Use when testing microservice integrations, verifying API contracts, preventing breaking changes, or implementing provider verification.
yonatangross/orchestkit/contract-testing.descriptionEn: Consumer-driven contract testing with Pact for API compatibility. Use when testing microservice integrations, verifying API contracts, preventing breaking changes, or implementing provider verification.
yonatangross/orchestkit/contract-testing.descriptionCn: 使用 Pact 进行消费者驱动的合同测试以实现 API 兼容性。在测试微服务集成、验证 API 合约、防止重大更改或实施提供程序验证时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/core-web-vitals.title: core-web-vitals
yonatangross/orchestkit/core-web-vitals.description: Core Web Vitals optimization for LCP, INP, CLS with 2026 thresholds, performance budgets, and RUM. Use when improving page performance, diagnosing CWV regressions, or setting performance budgets.
yonatangross/orchestkit/core-web-vitals.descriptionEn: Core Web Vitals optimization for LCP, INP, CLS with 2026 thresholds, performance budgets, and RUM. Use when improving page performance, diagnosing CWV regressions, or setting performance budgets.
yonatangross/orchestkit/core-web-vitals.descriptionCn: 针对 LCP、INP、CLS 的核心 Web Vitals 优化，包括 2026 年阈值、性能预算和 RUM。在提高页面性能、诊断 CWV 回归或设置性能预算时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/cover.title: cover
yonatangross/orchestkit/cover.description: Generate and run comprehensive test suites — unit tests, integration tests with real services (testcontainers/docker-compose), and Playwright E2E tests. Analyzes coverage gaps, spawns parallel test-generator agents per tier, runs tests, and heals failures (max 3 iterations). Use when generating tests for existing code, improving coverage after implementation, or creating a full test suite from scratch. Chains naturally after /ork:implement. Do NOT use for verifying/grading existing tests (use /ork:verify) or running tests without generation (use npm test directly).
yonatangross/orchestkit/cover.descriptionEn: Generate and run comprehensive test suites — unit tests, integration tests with real services (testcontainers/docker-compose), and Playwright E2E tests. Analyzes coverage gaps, spawns parallel test-generator agents per tier, runs tests, and heals failures (max 3 iterations). Use when generating tests for existing code, improving coverage after implementation, or creating a full test suite from scratch. Chains naturally after /ork:implement. Do NOT use for verifying/grading existing tests (use /ork:verify) or running tests without generation (use npm test directly).
yonatangross/orchestkit/cover.descriptionCn: 生成并运行全面的测试套件 - 单元测试、与实际服务的集成测试（testcontainers/docker-compose）以及 Playwright E2E 测试。分析覆盖范围差距，在每层生成并行测试生成器代理，运行测试并修复故障（最多 3 次迭代）。在为现有代码生成测试、提高实施后的覆盖率或从头开始创建完整的测试套件时使用。在 /ork:implement 之后自然链接。不要用于验证/分级现有测试（使用 /ork:verify）或运行测试而不生成（直接使用 npm test）。

yonatangross/orchestkit/cqrs-patterns.title: cqrs-patterns
yonatangross/orchestkit/cqrs-patterns.description: CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) patterns for separating read and write models. Use when optimizing read-heavy systems, implementing event sourcing, or building systems with different read/write scaling requirements.
yonatangross/orchestkit/cqrs-patterns.descriptionEn: CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) patterns for separating read and write models. Use when optimizing read-heavy systems, implementing event sourcing, or building systems with different read/write scaling requirements.
yonatangross/orchestkit/cqrs-patterns.descriptionCn: 用于分离读写模型的 CQRS（命令查询职责分离）模式。在优化读取密集型系统、实施事件源或构建具有不同读/写扩展要求的系统时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/create-pr.title: create-pr
yonatangross/orchestkit/create-pr.description: Create GitHub pull requests with validation and auto-generated descriptions. Use when creating pull requests, opening PRs, submitting code for review.
yonatangross/orchestkit/create-pr.descriptionEn: Create GitHub pull requests with validation and auto-generated descriptions. Use when creating pull requests, opening PRs, submitting code for review.
yonatangross/orchestkit/create-pr.descriptionCn: 使用验证和自动生成的描述创建 GitHub 拉取请求。在创建拉取请求、打开 PR、提交代码以供审核时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/dashboard-patter.title: dashboard-patterns
yonatangross/orchestkit/dashboard-patter.description: Dashboard UI patterns with widget composition, real-time data updates, responsive grid layouts, and data tables for React applications. Use when building dashboards, widgets, or data tables.
yonatangross/orchestkit/dashboard-patter.descriptionEn: Dashboard UI patterns with widget composition, real-time data updates, responsive grid layouts, and data tables for React applications. Use when building dashboards, widgets, or data tables.
yonatangross/orchestkit/dashboard-patter.descriptionCn: 仪表板 UI 模式，具有小部件组合、实时数据更新、响应式网格布局和 React 应用程序的数据表。在构建仪表板、小部件或数据表时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/database-pattern.title: database-patterns
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-pattern.description: Database design and migration patterns for Alembic migrations, schema design (SQL/NoSQL), and database versioning. Use when creating migrations, designing schemas, normalizing data, managing database versions, or handling schema drift.
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-pattern.descriptionEn: Database design and migration patterns for Alembic migrations, schema design (SQL/NoSQL), and database versioning. Use when creating migrations, designing schemas, normalizing data, managing database versions, or handling schema drift.
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-pattern.descriptionCn: Alembic 迁移、架构设计 (SQL/NoSQL) 和数据库版本控制的数据库设计和迁移模式。在创建迁移、设计架构、规范化数据、管理数据库版本或处理架构漂移时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/database-schema-.title: database-schema-designer
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-schema-.description: SQL and NoSQL schema design with normalization, indexing, and migration patterns. Use when designing database schemas, creating tables, optimizing slow queries, or planning database migrations.
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-schema-.descriptionEn: SQL and NoSQL schema design with normalization, indexing, and migration patterns. Use when designing database schemas, creating tables, optimizing slow queries, or planning database migrations.
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-schema-.descriptionCn: 具有规范化、索引和迁移模式的 SQL 和 NoSQL 架构设计。在设计数据库架构、创建表、优化慢速查询或规划数据库迁移时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/database-version.title: database-versioning
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-version.description: Database version control and change management patterns. Use when managing schema history, coordinating database changes across environments, implementing audit trails, or versioning database objects.
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-version.descriptionEn: Database version control and change management patterns. Use when managing schema history, coordinating database changes across environments, implementing audit trails, or versioning database objects.
yonatangross/orchestkit/database-version.descriptionCn: 数据库版本控制和变更管理模式。在管理架构历史记录、协调跨环境的数据库更改、实施审计跟踪或版本控制数据库对象时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/decision-history.title: decision-history
yonatangross/orchestkit/decision-history.description: Visualize OrchestKit architecture decisions over time, tracking CC version evolution and best practices adoption. Use when reviewing decisions, understanding rationale, or generating timeline docs.
yonatangross/orchestkit/decision-history.descriptionEn: Visualize OrchestKit architecture decisions over time, tracking CC version evolution and best practices adoption. Use when reviewing decisions, understanding rationale, or generating timeline docs.
yonatangross/orchestkit/decision-history.descriptionCn: 随着时间的推移可视化 OrchestKit 架构决策，跟踪 CC 版本演变和最佳实践采用。在审查决策、理解基本原理或生成时间线文档时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/defense-in-depth.title: defense-in-depth
yonatangross/orchestkit/defense-in-depth.description: Use when building secure AI pipelines or hardening LLM integrations. Defense-in-depth implements 8 validation layers from edge to storage with no single point of failure.
yonatangross/orchestkit/defense-in-depth.descriptionEn: Use when building secure AI pipelines or hardening LLM integrations. Defense-in-depth implements 8 validation layers from edge to storage with no single point of failure.
yonatangross/orchestkit/defense-in-depth.descriptionCn: 在构建安全的 AI 管道或强化 LLM 集成时使用。深度防御实现了从边缘到存储的 8 个验证层，没有单点故障。

yonatangross/orchestkit/demo-producer.title: demo-producer
yonatangross/orchestkit/demo-producer.description: Creates polished demo videos for skills, tutorials, and CLI demonstrations. Use when producing video showcases, marketing content, or terminal recordings.
yonatangross/orchestkit/demo-producer.descriptionEn: Creates polished demo videos for skills, tutorials, and CLI demonstrations. Use when producing video showcases, marketing content, or terminal recordings.
yonatangross/orchestkit/demo-producer.descriptionCn: 为技能、教程和 CLI 演示创建精美的演示视频。在制作视频展示、营销内容或终端录音时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/design-context-e.title: design-context-extract
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-context-e.description: Extract design DNA from existing app screenshots or live URLs using Google Stitch. Use when auditing an existing design, creating a design system from a live app, or ensuring new pages match an established visual identity.
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-context-e.descriptionEn: Extract design DNA from existing app screenshots or live URLs using Google Stitch. Produces color palettes, typography specs, spacing tokens, and component patterns as design-tokens.json or Tailwind config. Use when auditing an existing design, creating a design system from a live app, or ensuring new pages match an established visual identity.
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-context-e.descriptionCn: 使用 Google Stitch 从现有应用程序屏幕截图或实时 URL 中提取设计 DNA。生成调色板、排版规范、间距标记和组件模式作为 design-tokens.json 或 Tailwind 配置。在审核现有设计、从实时应用程序创建设计系统或确保新页面与已建立的视觉标识相匹配时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/design-ship.title: design-ship
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-ship.description: End-to-end Claude Design handoff to pull request: imports a handoff bundle from claude.ai/design, generates Storybook stories and Playwright tests, runs diff-aware browser verification, and opens a PR with the bundle URL, before/after screenshots, and coverage delta embedded in the body. The one-shot 'design URL in, reviewable PR out' workflow. Use when a designer or PM hands you a Claude Design URL and you want a PR back without intermediate steps.
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-ship.descriptionEn: End-to-end Claude Design handoff to pull request: imports a handoff bundle from claude.ai/design, generates Storybook stories and Playwright tests, runs diff-aware browser verification, and opens a PR with the bundle URL, before/after screenshots, and coverage delta embedded in the body. The one-shot 'design URL in, reviewable PR out' workflow. Use when a designer or PM hands you a Claude Design URL and you want a PR back without intermediate steps.
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-ship.descriptionCn: 端到端 Claude Design 切换到拉取请求：从 claude.ai/design 导入切换包，生成 Storybook 故事和 Playwright 测试，运行差异感知浏览器验证，并打开一个 PR，其中包含包 URL、之前/之后的屏幕截图以及嵌入在正文中的覆盖范围增量。一次性“输入 URL 设计，输出可审查 PR”工作流程。当设计师或 PM 向您提供 Claude Design URL 并且您希望无需中间步骤即可返回 PR 时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/design-system-st.title: design-system-starter
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-system-st.description: Use this skill when creating or evolving design systems for applications. Provides design token structures, component architecture patterns, documentation templates, and accessibility guidelines. Ensures consistent, scalable, and accessible UI design across products.
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-system-st.descriptionEn: Use this skill when creating or evolving design systems for applications. yonatangross/orchestkit/design-system-st.descriptionCn: 在为应用程序创建或改进设计系统时使用此技能。提供设计令牌结构、组件架构模式、文档模板和可访问性指南。确保跨产品的一致、可扩展且可访问的 UI 设计。

yonatangross/orchestkit/design-system-to.title: design-system-tokens

yonatangross/orchestkit/design-system-to.descriptionEn: Design token management with W3C Design Token Community Group specification, three-tier token hierarchy (global/alias/component), OKLCH color spaces, Style Dictionary transformation, and dark mode theming. yonatangross/orchestkit/design-system-to.descriptionCn: 使用 W3C 设计令牌社区组规范、三层令牌层次结构（全局/别名/组件）、OKLCH 颜色空间、样式字典转换和暗模式主题来设计令牌管理。在创建设计令牌文件、实现主题系统、管理令牌版本控制或构建设计到代码管道时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/design-to-code.title: design-to-code
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-to-code.description: Mockup-to-component pipeline using Google Stitch, 21st.dev, and Storybook MCP. Accepts screenshots, descriptions, or URLs as input and produces production-ready React components. Checks existing Storybook components before generating, orchestrates design extraction via Stitch MCP, component matching via 21st.dev registry, adaptation to project design tokens, and self-healing verification via run-story-tests. Use when converting visual designs to code, implementing UI from mockups, or building components from screenshots.
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-to-code.descriptionEn: Mockup-to-component pipeline using Google Stitch, 21st.dev, and Storybook MCP. Accepts screenshots, descriptions, or URLs as input and produces production-ready React components. Checks existing Storybook components before generating, orchestrates design extraction via Stitch MCP, component matching via 21st.dev registry, adaptation to project design tokens, and self-healing verification via run-story-tests. Use when converting visual designs to code, implementing UI from mockups, or building components from screenshots.
yonatangross/orchestkit/design-to-code.descriptionCn: 使用 Google Stitch、21st.dev 和 Storybook MCP 的模型到组件管道。接受屏幕截图、描述或 URL 作为输入，并生成可用于生产的 React 组件。在生成之前检查现有的 Storybook 组件，通过 Stitch MCP 协调设计提取，通过 21st.dev 注册表进行组件匹配，适应项目设计令牌，并通过 run-story-tests 进行自我修复验证。将视觉设计转换为代码、从模型实现 UI 或从屏幕截图构建组件时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/devops-deploymen.title: devops-deployment
yonatangross/orchestkit/devops-deploymen.description: Use when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, deploying to Kubernetes, or writing infrastructure as code. DevOps & Deployment covers GitHub Actions, Docker, Helm, and Terraform patterns.
yonatangross/orchestkit/devops-deploymen.descriptionEn: Use when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, deploying to Kubernetes, or writing infrastructure as code. DevOps & Deployment covers GitHub Actions, Docker, Helm, and Terraform patterns.
yonatangross/orchestkit/devops-deploymen.descriptionCn: 在设置 CI/CD 管道、容器化应用程序、部署到 Kubernetes 或将基础架构编写为代码时使用。 DevOps 和部署涵盖 GitHub Actions、Docker、Helm 和 Terraform 模式。

yonatangross/orchestkit/distributed-lock.title: distributed-locks

yonatangross/orchestkit/distributed-lock.descriptionEn: Distributed locking patterns with Redis and PostgreSQL for coordination across instances. Use when implementing exclusive access, preventing race conditions, or coordinating distributed resources.

yonatangross/orchestkit/distributed-syst.title: distributed-systems

yonatangross/orchestkit/distributed-syst.descriptionEn: Distributed systems patterns for locking, resilience, idempotency, and rate limiting. Use when implementing distributed locks, circuit breakers, retry policies, idempotency keys, token bucket rate limiters, or fault tolerance patterns.
yonatangross/orchestkit/distributed-syst.descriptionCn: 用于锁定、弹性、幂等性和速率限制的分布式系统模式。在实现分布式锁、断路器、重试策略、幂等性密钥、令牌桶速率限制器或容错模式时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/doctor.title: doctor

yonatangross/orchestkit/doctor.descriptionEn: OrchestKit health diagnostics command that validates plugin configuration and reports issues. Use when running doctor checks or troubleshooting plugin health.
yonatangross/orchestkit/doctor.descriptionCn: OrchestKit 健康诊断命令，用于验证插件配置并报告问题。在运行医生检查或排除插件运行状况故障时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/dream.title: dream

yonatangross/orchestkit/dream.descriptionEn: Nightly memory consolidation — prunes stale entries, merges duplicates, resolves contradictions, rebuilds MEMORY.md index. yonatangross/orchestkit/expect.title: expect
yonatangross/orchestkit/expect.description: Diff-aware AI browser testing — analyzes git changes, generates targeted test plans, and executes them via agent-browser. Reads git diff to determine what changed, maps changes to affected pages via route map, generates a test plan scoped to the diff, and runs it with pass/fail reporting. Use when testing UI changes, verifying PRs before merge, running regression checks on changed components, or validating that recent code changes don't break the user-facing experience.
yonatangross/orchestkit/expect.descriptionEn: Diff-aware AI browser testing — analyzes git changes, generates targeted test plans, and executes them via agent-browser. Reads git diff to determine what changed, maps changes to affected pages via route map, generates a test plan scoped to the diff, and runs it with pass/fail reporting. Use when testing UI changes, verifying PRs before merge, running regression checks on changed components, or validating that recent code changes don't break the user-facing experience.
yonatangross/orchestkit/expect.descriptionCn: Diff-aware AI 浏览器测试——分析 git 更改，生成有针对性的测试计划，并通过代理浏览器执行它们。读取 git diff 以确定更改的内容，通过路线图将更改映射到受影响的页面，生成范围为 diff 的测试计划，并通过通过/失败报告运行它。在测试 UI 更改、在合并之前验证 PR、对更改的组件运行回归检查或验证最近的代码更改不会破坏面向用户的体验时使用。

yonatangross/orchestkit/plan-viz.title: plan-viz
yonatangross/orchestkit/plan-viz.description: Visualize planned changes before implementation. Use when reviewing plans, comparing before/after architecture, assessing risk, or analyzing execution order and impact.
yonatangross/orchestkit/plan-viz.descriptionEn: Visualize planned changes before implementation. Use when reviewing plans, comparing before/after architecture, assessing risk, or analyzing execution order and impact.

yonatangross/orchestkit/portless.title: portless
yonatangross/orchestkit/portless.description: Named .localhost URLs for local development with portless. Eliminates port collisions, enables stable URLs for agents, integrates with emulate for API emulation aliases and git worktrees for branch-named subdomains. Use when setting up local dev environments, configuring agent-accessible URLs, or running multi-service dev setups. Do NOT use for production deployments, CI environments (set PORTLESS=0), or DNS/hosting configuration.
yonatangross/orchestkit/portless.descriptionEn: Named .localhost URLs for local development with portless. Eliminates port collisions, enables stable URLs for agents, integrates with emulate for API emulation aliases and git worktrees for branch-named subdomains. Use when setting up local dev environments, configuring agent-accessible URLs, or running multi-service dev setups. Do NOT use for production deployments, CI environments (set PORTLESS=0), or DNS/hosting configuration.
yonatangross/orchestkit/portless.descriptionCn: 名为 .localhost URL，用于无端口本地开发。消除端口冲突，为代理提供稳定的 URL，与 API 模拟别名的 emulate 集成，并与分支命名的子域的 git 工作树集成。在设置本地开发环境、配置代理可访问的 URL 或运行多服务开发设置时使用。请勿用于生产部署、CI 环境（设置 PORTLESS=0）或 DNS/托管配置。

yonatangross/orchestkit/presentation-bui.title: presentation-builder
yonatangross/orchestkit/presentation-bui.description: Creates zero-dependency, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. Use when the user wants to build a presentation, convert a PPT/PPTX to web slides, or create a slide deck for a talk, pitch, or tutorial. Generates single self-contained HTML files with inline CSS/JS.
yonatangross/orchestkit/presentation-bui.descriptionEn: Creates zero-dependency, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. Use when the user wants to build a presentation, convert a PPT/PPTX to web slides, or create a slide deck for a talk, pitch, or tutorial. Generates single self-contained HTML files with inline CSS/JS.
yonatangross/orchestkit/presentation-bui.descriptionCn: 从头开始或通过转换 PowerPoint 文件创建零依赖性、动画丰富的 HTML 演示文稿。当用户想要构建演示文稿、将 PPT/PPTX 转换为 Web 幻灯片或为演讲、推介或教程创建幻灯片时使用。使用内联 CSS/JS 生成单个独立的 HTML 文件。

yonatangross/orchestkit/prioritization.title: prioritization

yonatangross/orchestkit/prioritization.descriptionEn: Prioritization frameworks — RICE, WSJF, ICE, MoSCoW, and opportunity cost scoring for backlog ranking. Use when prioritizing features, comparing initiatives, justifying roadmap decisions, or evaluating trade-offs between competing work items.

yonatangross/orchestkit/prioritization-f.title: prioritization-frameworks

yonatangross/orchestkit/product-framewor.title: product-frameworks

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-lear.title: bid-learner
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-lear.description:
投标业务专用经验学习器。从对话中提取投标相关的错误、问题和经验教训， 自动注入到 bid-* skills 的 gotchas.md 文件中。
严格限定范围：仅处理投标业务（招标分析、响应文件编写、质检等）， 不学习通用编程、其他领域知识。
触发条件： 1. 用户说"记住这个错误" / "记住这次教训" / "总结经验" / "学习这个案例" 2. 用户明确要求"更新 bid-XXX 的 gotchas" 3. 用户说"投标经验记录" / "标书问题记录"
前置条件： - 当前对话必须在投标项目上下文中（有招标文件、分析报告、响应文件等） - 最近调用过至少一个 bid-* skill
不触发条件： ❌ 非投标相关对话 ❌ 用户只是抱怨但没明确要求记录 ❌ 问题与 bid 业务无关（如通用代码错误）

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mana.title: bid-manager
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mana.description: 投标全流程管理器。编排所有 bid skills 按流水线自动执行，支持一键投标、 断点续跑、指定阶段启动。10个阶段：分析→核实→信息收集→商务标→技术标→ 图表→扫描件→质检→自动修复→生成Word。 当用户要求一键投标、全流程投标、管理投标进度、继续投标流程时触发。 前置条件：需要有招标/磋商/采购文件。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mate.title: bid-material-extraction
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mate.description: 从投标/响应文件中提取可复用资料。三步流水线： (1) 提取文档目录 → toc.json (2) LLM 判断哪些章节需要提取 → extraction_plan.json (3) 按计划提取文本和图片 → 文件系统 当用户需要从已有投标文件中提取资料建立复用库时触发。 提取完成后，检索服务由 bid-material-search skill 提供。
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mate.descriptionEn: 从投标/响应文件中提取可复用资料。三步流水线： (1) 提取文档目录 → toc.json (2) LLM 判断哪些章节需要提取 → extraction_plan.json (3) 按计划提取文本和图片 → 文件系统 当用户需要从已有投标文件中提取资料建立复用库时触发。 提取完成后，检索服务由 bid-material-search skill 提供。
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mate.descriptionCn: 从投标/响应文件中提取可重复使用的材料。三步流程：（1）提取文档大纲→toc.json（2）LLM确定哪些部分需要提取→extraction_plan.json（3）根据计划提取文本和图像→文件系统。当用户需要从现有招标文件中提取材料以构建重用库时触发。提取完成后，由投标材料搜索技能提供检索服务。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mate.title: bid-material-search
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mate.description: 投标资料检索 skill（MCP 重构版）- 直接调用 MaterialHub API 进行材料搜索、数据提取和占位符替换。 相比旧版本移除了 FastAPI 中间层，简化架构，提升性能。 当用户需要查询投标资料（营业执照、证书、合同、业绩等）、提取公司或人员的结构化信息、 或替换响应文件中的【此处插入XX扫描件】占位符时触发。 前置条件：MaterialHub API 服务已运行（通过 .mcp.json 配置），材料已上传到 MaterialHub。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-mate.descriptionCn: 标书检索技巧（MCP重构版）——直接调用MaterialHub API进行材料搜索、数据提取、占位符替换。相比老版本，去掉了FastAPI中间层，简化了架构，提升了性能。当用户需要查询投标文件（营业执照、证书、合同、业绩记录等）、提取企业或人员的结构化信息、替换响应文件中的占位符【在此插入XX扫描件】时触发。前提条件：MaterialHub API服务已运行（通过.mcp.json配置），并且材质已上传到MaterialHub。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-md2d.title: bid-md2doc
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-md2d.description: 将 响应文件/ 目录下的 Markdown 文件转换为格式化的 Word (.docx) 文档。 自动从分析报告和商务文件中读取项目名称、公司名称等信息， 通过命令行参数调用 generate_docx.js 脚本生成 Word 文件。 当用户要求生成Word文档、转换MD为docx、导出响应文件时触发。 前置条件：响应文件/ 目录下已有编写完成的 .md 文件。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-md2d.descriptionCn: 将响应文件/目录中的 Markdown 文件转换为格式化的 Word (.docx) 文档。自动从分析报告和业务文档中提取项目名称、公司名称等信息，并通过命令行参数调用generate_docx.js脚本生成Word文件。当用户请求生成Word文档、将MD转换为docx或导出响应文件时会触发此操作。前提条件：响应文件/目录中已存在已完成的.md 文件。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-merm.title: bid-mermaid-diagrams
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-merm.description: 为投标文件中的图表占位符生成 Mermaid 图并渲染为 PNG 图片。 扫描 markdown 文件中的【此处插入XX图】占位符，根据上下文（ASCII 图、 描述文字、章节标题）生成对应的 Mermaid 代码，渲染为高清 PNG， 然后替换占位符为 markdown 图片引用。 当用户要求画图、生成图表、替换图表占位符、为技术方案/实施方案画架构图时触发。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-ppt.title: bid-ppt

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-requ.title: bid-requirements
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-requ.description: 通用的工程级需求规格编写范式。适用于任何行业、任何标书的需求细化。 采用两阶段架构：Phase 0 分析标书生成项目元数据（行业领域、角色、术语、数据约定等）， Phase 1 将元数据套入通用编写模板，按系统逐个生成详细需求规格。 当用户要求编写需求分析、需求规格、需求细化、展开功能需求时触发。 也支持修复模式：当用户要求修复/补充需求文档、处理评审反馈时触发。 前置条件：需已有投标响应文件或功能需求清单。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-requ.descriptionCn: 通用工程级需求规范编写范例。适用于任何行业和任何招标要求细化。采用两阶段架构：Phase0分析标书生成项目元数据（行业领域、角色、术语、数据约定等）；第一阶段将元数据应用到通用编写模板中，逐个系统生成详细的需求规格。当用户请求编写需求分析、需求规格说明、需求细化或详细说明功能需求时触发。它还支持修复模式：当用户请求修复/补充需求文档或处理评审反馈时触发。先决条件：投标响应文件或功能需求列表必须已存在。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-soft.title: bid-software-design
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-soft.description: 基于需求规格编写软件概要设计和详细设计文档。从需求元数据和各系统需求规格中读取业务对象、 接口、用例等信息，生成数据库设计、API设计、模块设计等工程级设计文档。 采用三阶段架构：Phase 0 生成设计元数据，Phase 1 按系统生成概要设计，Phase 2 按子模块生成详细设计。 核心特性：大文档自动拆分，按系统规模分级处理（小/中/大），避免单次输出过大。 当用户要求编写软件设计、概要设计、详细设计、数据库设计、API设计时触发。 也支持修复模式：当用户要求修复/补充设计文档时触发。 前置条件：需已完成 bid-requirements 生成需求规格文件。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-soft.descriptionCn: 根据需求说明书，编写软件高层设计和详细设计文档。从需求元数据和各系统需求规范中读取业务对象、接口、用例等信息，生成数据库设计、API设计、模块设计等工程级设计文档。使用三阶段架构：阶段 0 生成设计元数据，阶段 1 创建每个系统的高级设计，阶段 2 创建每个子模块的详细设计。核心特点：大文档自动拆分，根据系统规模（小/中/大）进行分层处理，避免单次输出过大。当用户请求软件设计、高层设计、详细设计、数据库设计或API设计时触发。它还支持修复模式：当用户请求修复或补充设计文档时触发。先决条件：投标要求必须已经生成需求规格文件。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-tech.title: bid-tech-proposal
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-tech.description: 编写投标/响应文件的技术标部分。从分析报告中动态读取评分标准和技术需求， 按评分维度逆向设计章节结构，逐文件编写技术方案、技术服务响应表、培训方案等。 输出Markdown格式文件到 响应文件/ 目录。 当用户要求编写技术标、技术方案、技术响应文件时触发。 也支持修复模式：当用户要求修复/补充技术文件、处理质检反馈时触发。 前置条件：需已完成 bid-analysis 生成分析报告。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-veri.title: bid-verification
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-veri.description: 对招标文件分析报告进行逐项核实，与原始采购文件交叉验证每一个关键数据点。 检查分析报告中的金额、分值、资格条件、时间节点、评分规则等是否与原文一致， 识别幻觉数据、遗漏信息、数值错误。当用户要求核实/校验/审核分析报告时触发。
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-veri.descriptionEn: 对招标文件分析报告进行逐项核实，与原始采购文件交叉验证每一个关键数据点。 检查分析报告中的金额、分值、资格条件、时间节点、评分规则等是否与原文一致， 识别幻觉数据、遗漏信息、数值错误。当用户要求核实/校验/审核分析报告时触发。
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bid-veri.descriptionCn: 对招标文件分析报告进行逐项核查，将各关键数据点与原始采购文件进行交叉核对。检查分析报告中的金额、分数、资格标准、时间线、评分规则等是否与原文一致，并识别虚假数据、缺失信息和数值错误。当用户请求验证/验证/审计分析报告时触发此操作。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bigmodel.title: bigmodel-ocr
youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bigmodel.description: 使用智谱 BigModel OCR API 对图片和 PDF 页面进行文字识别。 支持中英文混排、手写体、印刷体，内置内容级缓存避免重复请求。 输出为结构化 JSON（含逐页文本、token 估算、表格检测）。 当用户需要对 PDF 扫描件、证书图片、合同扫描页进行 OCR 文字识别时触发。 也适用于从营业执照、资质证书、身份证等材料图片中提取文字信息。

youyouhe/bidsmart-claude-skills/bigmodel.descriptionCn: 使用ZhiPu BigModel OCR API对图像和PDF页面进行文本识别。它支持中英文混合、手写和打印文本，并包含内置内容级缓存以防止重复请求。输出是结构化 JSON（包含每页文本、标记估计和表检测）。当用户需要对 PDF 扫描、证书图像或合同扫描页面进行 OCR 时，会触发此操作。它还适用于从营业执照、资格证书、身份证和类似文件的图像中提取文本。

ypjun100/butter-workflow/butter-workflow.title: butter-workflow-code-review
ypjun100/butter-workflow/butter-workflow.description:
Trigger: docs/specs/{TASK-ID}/00-META.md exists with Status implemented or a recorded PR URL, and the user asks for that change to be reviewed ("review this PR", "check this diff"). Both conditions are required. Collects track-specific context (issue, plan, task, risk targets), reviews the diff and review comments, applies safe fixes, and escalates design or scope-changing feedback.
Skip: no docs/specs/{TASK-ID}/00-META.md exists — this is not a Butter Workflow, so handle the review request directly rather than pulling in this stage. Also skip when the user only wants specific feedback applied — apply, verify, commit, and push it directly. Also skip when nothing is implemented yet — use `butter-workflow-implement` first.

ypjun100/butter-workflow/butter-workflow.descriptionCn:
触发器：docs/specs/{TASK-ID}/00-META.md 存在，状态已实施或已记录 PR URL，并且用户要求审核该更改（“审核此 PR”、“检查此差异”）。这两个条件都是必需的。收集特定于轨道的上下文（问题、计划、任务、风险目标），审查差异和审查意见，应用安全修复，并升级设计或范围更改反馈。
跳过：不存在 docs/specs/{TASK-ID}/00-META.md — 这不是 Butter 工作流程，因此直接处理审核请求，而不是在此阶段拉取。当用户只想应用特定反馈时也可以跳过——应用、验证、提交和直接推送。当尚未实现任何内容时也可以跳过 - 首先使用“butter-workflow-implement”。

ypjun100/butter-workflow/butter-workflow.title: butter-workflow-implement
ypjun100/butter-workflow/butter-workflow.description:
Trigger: docs/specs/{TASK-ID}/00-META.md exists with Status planned, and the user approves that spec or asks for it to be built ("implement this", "build the approved plan", "continue the implementation"). Both conditions are required. Reads workflow state, applies the approved track scope, runs verification, commits task-sized changes, pushes, and creates or updates a PR.
Skip: no docs/specs/{TASK-ID}/00-META.md exists — the user never started a Butter Workflow, so do the requested work directly rather than pulling in this stage. Also skip for spec-file edits and single follow-up fixes inside an active workflow — apply those directly. Also skip once a PR already exists and is awaiting review — use `butter-workflow-code-review` instead.

跳过：不存在 docs/specs/{TASK-ID}/00-META.md — 用户从未启动 Butter 工作流程，因此直接执行请求的工作，而不是在此阶段拉取。还可以跳过活动工作流程中的规范文件编辑和单个后续修复 - 直接应用它们。一旦 PR 已经存在并等待审核，也可以跳过 — 使用“butter-workflow-code-review”代替。

Classifies Track A/B/C, plans the working branch, bootstraps shared preference data, and writes docs/specs/{TASK-ID} spec files for every track before pausing for approval.
Skip: the request only describes work to do — "start this task", "let's plan this out", a pasted issue link — without naming this skill or Butter Workflow; do that work directly instead. yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-citation.descriptionCn: 通过将长段落分割成可引用的片段，仅搜索 Nature Portfolio、AAAS Science 系列和 Cell Press 中接受的旗舰期刊和子期刊标题，按出版时间范围进行过滤，并默认导出一份可供参考管理器使用的输出，将严格的 Nature/CNS 引文添加到手稿文本中。每当用户要求输入文本并自动获取参考文献、向段落/手稿添加引文、查找 Nature-series 或 CNS 对语句的支持、创建文本到参考文献的对应关系、“分段引用”、“自动给出引用”、“Nature 系列引用”、“CNS 及子刊”、“支撑文献”、“补引用”、“查找引用”或导出 EndNote/RIS/ENW/Zotero RDF 时，请使用此技能。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-data.title: nature-data
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-data.description: Prepare, audit, or revise Nature-ready Data Availability statements, data repository plans, dataset citations, and FAIR metadata checklists for manuscripts. Use when the user asks about Nature data availability, research data sharing, repository selection, accession numbers, restricted or sensitive data, source data, supplementary datasets, DataCite-style dataset references, FAIR metadata for academic publication, or Chinese-to-English data availability wording for Chinese-speaking authors preparing Nature-family submissions.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-data.descriptionEn: Prepare, audit, or revise Nature-ready Data Availability statements, data repository plans, dataset citations, and FAIR metadata checklists for manuscripts. Use when the user asks about Nature data availability, research data sharing, repository selection, accession numbers, restricted or sensitive data, source data, supplementary datasets, DataCite-style dataset references, FAIR metadata for academic publication, or Chinese-to-English data availability wording for Chinese-speaking authors preparing Nature-family submissions.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-data.descriptionCn: 准备、审核或修改稿件的 Nature-ready 数据可用性声明、数据存储库计划、数据集引用和 FAIR 元数据清单。当用户询问 Nature 数据可用性、研究数据共享、存储库选择、登录号、受限或敏感数据、源数据、补充数据集、DataCite 式数据集引用、学术出版物的 FAIR 元数据或准备向 Nature 系列提交的中文作者的中英数据可用性措辞时使用。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-download.title: nature-downloader
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-download.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to configure school/library access, reuse a logged-in Chrome institutional session, search library databases, download legitimate open-access or institution-authorized academic full text/PDFs, handle missing library permission, organize papers, or read PDFs and supporting information.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-download.descriptionEn: Use this skill whenever the user wants to configure school/library access, reuse a logged-in Chrome institutional session, search library databases, download legitimate open-access or institution-authorized academic full text/PDFs, handle missing library permission, organize papers, or read PDFs and supporting information.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-download.descriptionCn: 每当用户想要配置学校/图书馆访问、重复使用登录的 Chrome 机构会话、搜索图书馆数据库、下载合法的开放获取或机构授权的学术全文/PDF、处理缺少的图书馆权限、组织论文或阅读 PDF 和支持信息时，请使用此技能。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-experime.title: nature-experiment-log
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-experime.description: 标准化实验日志记录——接收原始材料（图/语音/文字），产出带 YAML frontmatter 的标准日志到 Obsidian vault。需配合飞书 CLI 或手动输入使用。
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-experime.descriptionEn: 标准化实验日志记录——接收原始材料（图/语音/文字），产出带 YAML frontmatter 的标准日志到 Obsidian vault。需配合飞书 CLI 或手动输入使用。
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-experime.descriptionCn: 标准化实验日志记录——接收原材料（图像/音频/文本）并将带有 YAML frontmatter 的标准日志输出到 Obsidian 保险库。必须配合飞书CLI使用或手动输入。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-figure.title: nature-figure
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-figure.description: Publication-ready matplotlib figures for Nature/high-impact journals and academic papers. Covers bar charts, grouped bars, heatmaps, line/trend plots, forest plots, microscopy-style image panels, schematic + quantitative composites, radar plots, and multi-panel layouts with Nature-style typography (Arial/sans-serif), restrained color systems, and SVG/PDF export conventions. Use when creating scientific figures that must match Nature publication standards. Do NOT use for interactive dashboards (Plotly, Bokeh) or Illustrator/Figma-first infographic workflows.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-figure.descriptionEn: Publication-ready matplotlib figures for Nature/high-impact journals and academic papers. Covers bar charts, grouped bars, heatmaps, line/trend plots, forest plots, microscopy-style image panels, schematic + quantitative composites, radar plots, and multi-panel layouts with Nature-style typography (Arial/sans-serif), restrained color systems, and SVG/PDF export conventions. Use when creating scientific figures that must match Nature publication standards. Do NOT use for interactive dashboards (Plotly, Bokeh) or Illustrator/Figma-first infographic workflows.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-figure.descriptionCn: 用于自然/高影响力期刊和学术论文的可出版的 matplotlib 图形。涵盖条形图、分组条形图、热图、线/趋势图、森林图、显微镜式图像面板、原理图 + 定量合成图、雷达图和具有自然风格排版（Arial/sans-serif）的多面板布局、受限颜色系统和 SVG/PDF 导出约定。在创建必须符合《自然》出版标准的科学图表时使用。请勿用于交互式仪表板（Plotly、Bokeh）或 Illustrator/Figma 优先的信息图表工作流程。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-image2pp.title: nature-image2ppt
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-image2pp.description: Convert slide images, screenshots, scanned PDFs, and image-only PPT/PPTX files into high-fidelity object-level editable PowerPoint, including semantic-region mixed reconstruction, measured flowcharts and knowledge graphs, native circle nodes and connectors, single-object thin and filled arrows, speaker-note preservation, and rendered QA. Use for 图片转可编辑PPT、截图还原PPT、扫描PDF恢复、图片型PPTX转换、流程图/知识图谱/复合图形/箭头重建; not for authoring a new deck from notes.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-image2pp.descriptionEn: Convert slide images, screenshots, scanned PDFs, and image-only PPT/PPTX files into high-fidelity object-level editable PowerPoint, including semantic-region mixed reconstruction, measured flowcharts and knowledge graphs, native circle nodes and connectors, single-object thin and filled arrows, speaker-note preservation, and rendered QA. Use for 图片转可编辑PPT、截图还原PPT、扫描PDF恢复、图片型PPTX转换、流程图/知识图谱/复合图形/箭头重建; not for authoring a new deck from notes.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-image2pp.descriptionCn: 将幻灯片图像、屏幕截图、扫描的 PDF 和纯图像 PPT/PPTX 文件转换为高保真对象级可编辑 PowerPoint，包括语义区域混合重建、测量流程图和知识图、原生圆节点和连接器、单对象细箭头和填充箭头、演讲者注释保存和渲染 QA。用于图片还原可编辑PPT、截图PPT、扫描PDF恢复、图片型PPTX转换、流程图/知识图谱/复合图形/箭头重建；不是为了根据笔记创作新的套牌。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-literatu.title: nature-literature-pipeline
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-literatu.description:
Complete automated literature discovery pipeline: multi-source search → six-dimension scoring → fine reading → formatted delivery → archival.
Combines a configurable engine with daily cron-driven application layer. Works with Feishu, Telegram, or any messaging platform.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-literatu.descriptionEn:
Complete automated literature discovery pipeline: multi-source search → six-dimension scoring → fine reading → formatted delivery → archival.
Combines a configurable engine with daily cron-driven application layer. Works with Feishu, Telegram, or any messaging platform.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-literatu.descriptionCn:
完整的自动化文献发现流程：多源检索→六维评分→精读→格式化交付→归档。
将可配置引擎与日常 cron 驱动的应用程序层相结合。可与飞书、Telegram 或任何消息平台配合使用。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper-ca.title: nature-paper-card
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper-ca.description: Build a source-grounded deep-reading Paper Card for one scientific paper, preprint, PDF, DOI, arXiv page, publisher article, or pasted paper text. Use when the user asks for a Paper Card, deep-reading literature card, single-paper deep analysis, module-by-module analysis, experiment-to-claim evidence chain, conclusion-boundary audit, critical analysis, knowledge connections, or candidate research ideas. Produce the fixed Sections 01-16 covering bibliographic position, research question, background route, pain point, core insight, method and module logic, essential formulas, experiment-to-claim evidence, conclusion boundaries, author-stated limitations, critical analysis, learned knowledge, knowledge connections, and testable research ideas. Do not use for full-paper bilingual translation, formal peer-review reports, batch literature monitoring, academic-English collection, comprehension quizzes, or public-article writing.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper-ca.descriptionEn: Build a source-grounded deep-reading Paper Card for one scientific paper, preprint, PDF, DOI, arXiv page, publisher article, or pasted paper text. Use when the user asks for a Paper Card, deep-reading literature card, single-paper deep analysis, module-by-module analysis, experiment-to-claim evidence chain, conclusion-boundary audit, critical analysis, knowledge connections, or candidate research ideas. Produce the fixed Sections 01-16 covering bibliographic position, research question, background route, pain point, core insight, method and module logic, essential formulas, experiment-to-claim evidence, conclusion boundaries, author-stated limitations, critical analysis, learned knowledge, knowledge connections, and testable research ideas. Do not use for full-paper bilingual translation, formal peer-review reports, batch literature monitoring, academic-English collection, comprehension quizzes, or public-article writing.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper-ca.descriptionCn: 为一篇科学论文、预印本、PDF、DOI、arXiv 页面、出版商文章或粘贴的纸质文本构建基于来源的深度阅读纸卡。当用户要求纸卡、深度阅读文献卡、单篇论文深度分析、逐个模块分析、实验到主张证据链、结论边界审核、批判性分析、知识联系或候选研究想法时使用。生成固定的第 01-16 节，涵盖书目位置、研究问题、背景路线、痛点、核心洞察、方法和模块逻辑、基本公式、实验到主张的证据、结论边界、作者陈述的局限性、批判性分析、学到的知识、知识联系和可测试的研究想法。请勿用于全文双语翻译、正式同行评审报告、批量文献监测、学术英语收集、理解测验或公开文章写作。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper-to.title: nature-paper-to-patent
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper-to.description: Convert scientific papers, theses, technical reports, source code, figures, or research manuscripts into evidence-grounded Chinese invention patent drafts. Use when an AI agent must extract patentable technical contributions, map every claimed feature to source evidence, preserve core formulas as editable Office Math, generate claim-aligned flowcharts and methodology figures, compare a paper with an existing patent, audit support and consistency, or deliver separate Chinese DOCX files for claims, specification, abstract, and abstract figure.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper-to.descriptionEn: Convert scientific papers, theses, technical reports, source code, figures, or research manuscripts into evidence-grounded Chinese invention patent drafts. Use when an AI agent must extract patentable technical contributions, map every claimed feature to source evidence, preserve core formulas as editable Office Math, generate claim-aligned flowcharts and methodology figures, compare a paper with an existing patent, audit support and consistency, or deliver separate Chinese DOCX files for claims, specification, abstract, and abstract figure.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper-to.descriptionCn: 将科学论文、论文、技术报告、源代码、图表或研究手稿转换为有证据支持的中国发明专利草案。当 AI 代理必须提取可专利的技术贡献、将每个声称的特征映射到来源证据、将核心公式保留为可编辑的 Office Math、生成与权利要求一致的流程图和方法图、将论文与现有专利进行比较、审核支持和一致性，或为权利要求、说明书、摘要和摘要图提供单独的中文 DOCX 文件时使用。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper2pp.title: nature-paper2ppt
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper2pp.description: Build a complete but efficient Nature-style Chinese PPTX presentation from a scientific paper, preprint, PDF, article text, abstract, figure legends, or reading notes. Use this skill whenever the user asks to make slides/PPT/PPTX for journal club, group meeting, paper sharing, thesis seminar, lab meeting, department report, or academic presentation from a research paper, not only medical papers. It identifies the paper type and argument, selects only the figures needed for the story, writes Chinese slide content and speaker notes, creates the actual .pptx deck, and performs lightweight verification without unnecessary rendering, exhaustive extraction, or extra files unless needed.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper2pp.descriptionEn: Build a complete but efficient Nature-style Chinese PPTX presentation from a scientific paper, preprint, PDF, article text, abstract, figure legends, or reading notes. Use this skill whenever the user asks to make slides/PPT/PPTX for journal club, group meeting, paper sharing, thesis seminar, lab meeting, department report, or academic presentation from a research paper, not only medical papers. It identifies the paper type and argument, selects only the figures needed for the story, writes Chinese slide content and speaker notes, creates the actual .pptx deck, and performs lightweight verification without unnecessary rendering, exhaustive extraction, or extra files unless needed.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-paper2pp.descriptionCn: 从科学论文、预印本、PDF、文章文本、摘要、人物图例或阅读笔记构建完整但高效的自然风格中文 PPTX 演示文稿。每当用户要求为期刊俱乐部、小组会议、论文共享、论文研讨会、实验室会议、部门报告或研究论文（而不仅仅是医学论文）的学术演示制作幻灯片/PPT/PPTX 时，请使用此技能。它识别论文类型和论点，仅选择故事所需的图形，编写中文幻灯片内容和演讲者注释，创建实际的 .pptx 幻灯片，并执行轻量级验证，无需不必要的渲染、详尽提取或额外文件（除非需要）。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-polishin.title: nature-polishing
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-polishin.description: Polish, restructure, or translate academic prose into Nature-leaning English using the paper-architecture and writing-strategy principles from Scientific English Writing & Communication, with phrase-level support from Academic Phrasebank. Use whenever the user asks to polish a manuscript paragraph, abstract, introduction, results, discussion, conclusion, title, methods section, or Chinese academic draft for publication-quality English.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-polishin.descriptionEn: Polish, restructure, or translate academic prose into Nature-leaning English using the paper-architecture and writing-strategy principles from Scientific English Writing & Communication, with phrase-level support from Academic Phrasebank. Use whenever the user asks to polish a manuscript paragraph, abstract, introduction, results, discussion, conclusion, title, methods section, or Chinese academic draft for publication-quality English.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-polishin.descriptionCn: 使用《科学英语写作与交流》中的论文架构和写作策略原则，在学术短语库的短语级支持下，将学术散文润色、重组或翻译成自然倾向的英语。每当用户要求润色手稿段落、摘要、引言、结果、讨论、结论、标题、方法部分或中文学术草稿以达到出版质量的英语时使用。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-reader.title: nature-reader
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-reader.description: Build full-text bilingual, figure-aware, source-grounded Markdown reading files for journal or conference papers from PDF, DOI, arXiv, publisher HTML, or pasted text. Use whenever the user asks to translate an entire paper, make a complete markdown reader, preserve figure or table placement near the relevant prose, or keep exact source anchors for every block. Do not use this for summaries, bullet-keyword notes, or citation-only tasks.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-reader.descriptionEn: Build full-text bilingual, figure-aware, source-grounded Markdown reading files for journal or conference papers from PDF, DOI, arXiv, publisher HTML, or pasted text. Use whenever the user asks to translate an entire paper, make a complete markdown reader, preserve figure or table placement near the relevant prose, or keep exact source anchors for every block. Do not use this for summaries, bullet-keyword notes, or citation-only tasks.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-reader.descriptionCn: 为来自 PDF、DOI、arXiv、出版商 HTML 或粘贴文本的期刊或会议论文构建全文双语、数字感知、基于源代码的 Markdown 阅读文件。每当用户要求翻译整篇论文、制作完整的 Markdown 阅读器、保留相关散文附近的图形或表格位置，或者为每个块保留准确的源锚点时，请使用。请勿将其用于摘要、关键词注释或仅引用的任务。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-ref-veri.title: nature-ref-verifier
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-ref-veri.description: 对学术文献逐条执行多源交叉验证，逐字段对比作者、标题、年份、卷期、页码， 标记卷年/DOI年冲突、作者顺序异常、页码偏差等问题，输出结构化验证报告。 可批量处理整篇论文/开题报告的参考文献列表，也可单条校验，支持与 Zotero 同步修正。
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-ref-veri.descriptionEn: 对学术文献逐条执行多源交叉验证，逐字段对比作者、标题、年份、卷期、页码， 标记卷年/DOI年冲突、作者顺序异常、页码偏差等问题，输出结构化验证报告。 可批量处理整篇论文/开题报告的参考文献列表，也可单条校验，支持与 Zotero 同步修正。
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-ref-veri.descriptionCn: 对学术参考文献逐项进行多源交叉验证，比较每个字段（作者、标题、年份、卷/期和页码），同时标记卷年/DOI 年份冲突、作者顺序异常和页码差异等问题，并生成结构化验证报告。它可以批量处理整个论文或提案的参考文献列表，以及验证单个条目，并支持与 Zotero 的同步和更正。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-response.title: nature-response
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-response.description: Draft, audit, or revise point-by-point reviewer response letters for Nature-family manuscript revisions. Use when the user provides reviewer comments, editor decision letters, revision notes, response drafts, or asks how to respond to major/minor revision requests, rebuttal letters, response to reviewers, peer-review reports, 审稿意见回复, 逐点回复, 修回信, 大修回复, 小修回复, or 如何回复 reviewer.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-response.descriptionEn: Draft, audit, or revise point-by-point reviewer response letters for Nature-family manuscript revisions. Use when the user provides reviewer comments, editor decision letters, revision notes, response drafts, or asks how to respond to major/minor revision requests, rebuttal letters, response to reviewers, peer-review reports, 审稿意见回复, 逐点回复, 修回信, 大修回复, 小修回复, or 如何回复 reviewer.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-response.descriptionCn: 起草、审核或修改自然系列手稿修订的逐点审稿人回复信。当用户提供审稿意见、编辑决定信、修改说明、回复草稿，或询问如何回复大/小修改请求、反驳信、回复审稿人、同行评审报告、审稿意见回复、逐点、修改回信、大修改回复、小修改回复或如何回复审稿人时使用。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-reviewer.title: nature-reviewer
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-reviewer.description: Simulate a Nature-style reviewer assessment from the referee perspective rather than an author rebuttal. Use when the user wants a pre-submission review, reviewer report, peer-review style critique, novelty/significance/technical soundness assessment, reviewer-style manuscript evaluation, 审稿人视角评估, 预审稿意见, or Nature reviewer report. Return 3 reviewer reports plus a cross-review synthesis, grounded only in the local Nature reviewer source basis.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-reviewer.descriptionEn: Simulate a Nature-style reviewer assessment from the referee perspective rather than an author rebuttal. Use when the user wants a pre-submission review, reviewer report, peer-review style critique, novelty/significance/technical soundness assessment, reviewer-style manuscript evaluation, 审稿人视角评估, 预审稿意见, or Nature reviewer report. Return 3 reviewer reports plus a cross-review synthesis, grounded only in the local Nature reviewer source basis.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-reviewer.descriptionCn: 从审稿人的角度而不是作者的反驳角度模拟自然风格的审稿人评估。当用户想要提交前审查、审稿人报告、同行评审风格批评、新颖性/重要性/技术健全性评估、审稿人风格手稿评估、审稿人视角评估、预审稿意见或 Nature 审稿人报告时使用。返回 3 份审稿人报告以及交叉审稿综合报告，仅以当地 Nature 审稿人来源为基础。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-shared.title: nature-shared
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-shared.description: Internal shared-reference support package for installed nature-writing, nature-polishing, nature-reader, and nature-paper2ppt skills. Do not invoke it as a standalone user workflow. Load only the specific core or journal-format file requested by another Nature skill.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-shared.descriptionEn: Internal shared-reference support package for installed nature-writing, nature-polishing, nature-reader, and nature-paper2ppt skills. Do not invoke it as a standalone user workflow. Load only the specific core or journal-format file requested by another Nature skill.
yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-shared.descriptionCn: 用于安装的自然写作、自然润色、自然阅读器和自然纸2ppt 技能的内部共享参考支持包。不要将其作为独立的用户工作流程调用。仅加载其他 Nature 技能请求的特定核心或日志格式文件。

yuan1z0825/nature-skills/nature-statisti.title: nature-statistics

yuanyang749/starlens/starlens.title: starlens

Trigger this skill when ANY of these contexts appear in the user's task — (1) the user is starting a coding task — before writing code, search StarLens for related libraries, frameworks, or prior art the user has already starred (recommend_for_task); (2) the user asks a technical question about libraries, tools, or frameworks — cite their starred repos as evidence or recommendations (search_stars / ask_stars); (3) the user mentions organizing, cleaning up, or reviewing their starred collection — suggest duplicates, stale repos, untagged high-star repos, or tag groupings (suggest_organization); (4) the user starts a new session or asks "what's new" — call get_sync_summary to report recently added/removed/changed stars since their last visit; (5) the user drops a repository for analysis — call analyze_repo to surface what the repo is good for and suggest tags/notes; (6) the user explicitly asks to star a repo on GitHub, unstar/remove a star from GitHub, or cleans up their collection and wants matching repos actually removed from their GitHub Stars (not just unfavorited locally) — call star_repo / unstar_repo. Also trigger when the user explicitly names a repository, topic, owner, or technology that may exist in their starred collection. Do NOT trigger for tasks unrelated to software development, library selection, or repository curation.

yunshu0909/yunshu_skillshub/req-change-w.title: req-change-workflow
yunshu0909/yunshu_skillshub/req-change-w.description: Standardize requirement/feature changes in an existing codebase (especially Chrome extensions) by turning "改需求/需求变更/调整交互/改功能/重构流程" into a repeatable loop: clarify acceptance criteria, confirm current behavior from code, assess impact/risk, design the new logic, implement with small diffs, run a fixed regression checklist, and update docs/decision log. Use when the user feels the change process is chaotic, when edits tend to sprawl across files, or when changes touch manifest/service worker/OAuth/storage/UI and need reliable verification + rollback planning.
yunshu0909/yunshu_skillshub/req-change-w.descriptionEn: Standardize requirement/feature changes in an existing codebase (especially Chrome extensions) by turning "改需求/需求变更/调整交互/改功能/重构流程" into a repeatable loop: clarify acceptance criteria, confirm current behavior from code, assess impact/risk, design the new logic, implement with small diffs, run a fixed regression checklist, and update docs/decision log. Use when the user feels the change process is chaotic, when edits tend to sprawl across files, or when changes touch manifest/service worker/OAuth/storage/UI and need reliable verification + rollback planning.
yunshu0909/yunshu_skillshub/req-change-w.descriptionCn: 通过将“改需求/需求变更/调整交互/改功能/重构流程”转变为可重复的循环，标准化现有代码库（尤其是 Chrome 扩展）中的需求/功能变更：澄清验收标准、确认代码中的当前行为、评估影响/风险、设计新逻辑、实现小差异、运行固定回归检查表以及更新文档/决策日志。当用户感觉更改过程混乱时，当编辑往往跨文件蔓延时，或者当更改涉及清单/服务工作人员/OAuth/存储/UI 并需要可靠的验证+回滚计划时，请使用。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.title: scope-guard
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.description: コミットやPR作成前に「意図しない差分」を検出し、ブランチ目的とのズレを警告する。 混入した無関係な変更の破棄コマンドまで提示する。コミット前のスコープ確認、 差分に余計なファイルが混ざっていないかのチェック、PRのスコープが広がりすぎていないかの 検証で使うこと。「このブランチの目的と関係ない変更が入っていないか？」という 疑問があれば必ず使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.descriptionEn: コミットやPR作成前に「意図しない差分」を検出し、ブランチ目的とのズレを警告する。 混入した無関係な変更の破棄コマンドまで提示する。コミット前のスコープ確認、 差分に余計なファイルが混ざっていないかのチェック、PRのスコープが広がりすぎていないかの 検証で使うこと。「このブランチの目的と関係ない変更が入っていないか？」という 疑問があれば必ず使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.descriptionCn: 在提交或 PR 创建之前检测“意外差异”，并在它们偏离分支目的时发出警报。它甚至建议命令放弃不相关的更改。使用它进行预提交范围检查，验证没有额外的文件混合到差异中，并确保 PR 不会变得太大。每当您想知道“是否包含与此分支的用途无关的任何更改？”时，请始终使用它。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.title: security-audit-quick
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.description: 高速静的セキュリティスキャン。grepベースで既知の危険パターン（XSS、SQLインジェクション、 ハードコード秘密鍵など）を網羅的に検出し、SEVERITY / file:line / why / fix 形式で 出力する再現可能なワークフロー。「コードベース全体をざっとセキュリティチェックしたい」 「既知の脆弱性パターンを一括検出したい」ときに使うこと。 security-hardeningスキル（特定の脅威シナリオに対する設計〜実装）や security-threat-reviewスキル（レッド/ブルーチームによる包括評価）とは異なり、 このスキルは既知パターンの高速検出に特化している。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.descriptionEn: 高速静的セキュリティスキャン。grepベースで既知の危険パターン（XSS、SQLインジェクション、 ハードコード秘密鍵など）を網羅的に検出し、SEVERITY / file:line / why / fix 形式で 出力する再現可能なワークフロー。「コードベース全体をざっとセキュリティチェックしたい」 「既知の脆弱性パターンを一括検出したい」ときに使うこと。 security-hardeningスキル（特定の脅威シナリオに対する設計〜実装）や security-threat-reviewスキル（レッド/ブルーチームによる包括評価）とは異なり、 このスキルは既知パターンの高速検出に特化している。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.descriptionCn: 高速静态安全扫描。基于 Grep 的已知危险模式（XSS、SQL 注入、硬编码机密等）的详尽检测，并以 SEVERITY / file:line / Why / fix 格式输出可重现的工作流程。当您想要“快速安全检查整个代码库”或“批量检测已知漏洞模式”时，请使用它。与安全强化技能（特定威胁场景的设计到实施）或安全威胁审查技能（全面的红/蓝团队评估）不同，该技能仅专注于已知模式的高速检测。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.title: security-hardening
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.description: 特定の脅威シナリオに対するセキュリティ強化ワークフロー。「IDORを防ぎたい」 「CSRFの対策を設計したい」「RLSを強化したい」のように、単一の具体的な脅威を入力に、 脅威モデル→緩和設計→実装方針→テスト/ログ→release-gate化まで一貫して成果物を出力する。 IDOR、リプレイ攻撃、CSRF、XSS、パストラバーサル、オープンリダイレクト、 レート制限設計など、特定の脆弱性への対処で使うこと。 「コードベース全体をスキャンしたい」場合はsecurity-audit-quickを、 「アプリ全体を包括評価したい」場合はsecurity-threat-reviewを使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.descriptionEn: 特定の脅威シナリオに対するセキュリティ強化ワークフロー。「IDORを防ぎたい」 「CSRFの対策を設計したい」「RLSを強化したい」のように、単一の具体的な脅威を入力に、 脅威モデル→緩和設計→実装方針→テスト/ログ→release-gate化まで一貫して成果物を出力する。 IDOR、リプレイ攻撃、CSRF、XSS、パストラバーサル、オープンリダイレクト、 レート制限設計など、特定の脆弱性への対処で使うこと。 「コードベース全体をスキャンしたい」場合はsecurity-audit-quickを、 「アプリ全体を包括評価したい」場合はsecurity-threat-reviewを使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.descriptionCn:
针对特定威胁场景的安全强化工作流程。  
输入单个具体威胁，例如“防止 IDOR”、“设计 CSRF 对策”或“加强 RLS”，它就会一致地提供来自威胁建模 → 缓解设计 → 实施计划 → 测试/记录 → 发布门的工件。  
使用它进行有针对性的修复：IDOR、重放攻击、CSRF、XSS、路径遍历、开放重定向、速率限制设计等。  
对于“扫描整个代码库”，请使用 security-audit-quick；对于“整体应用程序评估”，请使用 security-threat-review。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-threat-.title: security-threat-review
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-threat-.description: アプリ全体のセキュリティを攻撃者（レッドチーム）と防御者（ブルーチーム）の 2視点で包括評価する。2エージェント並列実行 → review-aggregator で統合レポートを出力する。 「アプリ全体のセキュリティ状態を知りたい」「攻撃者の視点で弱点を洗い出したい」 「防御体制に抜けがないか確認したい」ときに使うこと。 特定の脆弱性の対処にはsecurity-hardeningを、 既知パターンの高速検出にはsecurity-audit-quickを使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-threat-.descriptionEn: アプリ全体のセキュリティを攻撃者（レッドチーム）と防御者（ブルーチーム）の 2視点で包括評価する。2エージェント並列実行 → review-aggregator で統合レポートを出力する。 「アプリ全体のセキュリティ状態を知りたい」「攻撃者の視点で弱点を洗い出したい」 「防御体制に抜けがないか確認したい」ときに使うこと。 特定の脆弱性の対処にはsecurity-hardeningを、 既知パターンの高速検出にはsecurity-audit-quickを使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-threat-.descriptionCn: 从攻击者（红队）和防御者（蓝队）两个角度综合评估应用程序的整体安全性。并行运行两个代理→通过审查聚合器输出统一的报告。当您想要“了解整体安全态势”、“从攻击者的角度识别弱点”或“验证防御措施是否存在漏洞”时，请使用它。为了解决特定的漏洞，使用安全强化；要高速检测已知模式，请使用 security-audit-quick。

yzfly/cto-skills/cto.title: cto
yzfly/cto-skills/cto.description: Startup / AI-startup CTO who is also a top-tier individual contributor. Two modes: (1) greenfield — turn fuzzy business intent into a buildable design (brief.md, arch.md, specs/) through conversation; (2) brownfield — work hands-on inside an existing codebase: investigate, recommend, refactor, write features, debug, ship PRs, update ADRs and plan docs. Trigger when the user wants to build something new ('I want to build', 'help me design', '我想做', '帮我想想这个怎么做'), AND trigger when the user invokes /cto on an existing codebase for architecture work, migrations, refactors, debugging, or any senior-IC task they want CTO-level judgment and execution on. Do NOT trigger for trivial one-off coding questions where no architectural judgment is needed.

yzfly/cto-skills/cto.descriptionCn: 初创公司/人工智能初创公司 CTO，也是顶级个人贡献者。两种模式：（1）绿地——通过对话将模糊的业务意图转化为可构建的设计（brief.md、arch.md、specs/）； (2) 棕地——在现有代码库中实践：调查、推荐、重构、编写功能、调试、发布 PR、更新 ADR 和计划文档。当用户想要构建新东西时触发（“我想构建”、“帮我设计”、“我尝试”、“帮我想想这个怎么做”），当用户在现有代码库上调用 /cto 进行架构工作、迁移、重构、调试或他们想要 CTO 级别判断和执行的任何高级 IC 任务时触发。不要触发不需要架构判断的琐碎的一次性编码问题。

触发器：“将本文引入 wiki”/“总结 wiki 中有关 X 的内容”/“该 wiki 有矛盾的陈述 A 和 B，请帮助我协调它们”/“扫描 wiki 中的孤立页面/过时的摘要”/“升级 wiki/迁移到最新规范/检查 wiki 版本”/“将存储库 X（源代码）添加到 wiki”/“我想设置一个 wiki 来管理 X”。

不适用：云/团队协作 wiki（Notion/Confluence/Outline/GitHub Wiki - 使用 yz-r-outline-wiki）。

yzr95924/yzr-skill/yzr-llm-workspace-man.descriptionCn:
当用户需要管理由 **yzr-llm-wiki-management** 维护的多个本地 wiki 时，他们应该使用此技能：它在工作区级别扫描所有 wiki，生成并维护全局“INDEX.md”、“STATS.md”和“LINT.md”文件，执行跨 wiki 综合问答（路由、综合、比较、本地应答）、维护跨 wiki 引用、进行工作区级别的 linting 和合并跨 wiki 代理私有内存放入“MEMORY/”目录中。这弥补了工作区 CLI 的限制，它只能处理元数据而无法感知内容——CLI 负责确定性元数据操作，而该技能处理需要 LLM 判断的跨 wiki 决策。

**触发因素**包括：  
- “总结我所有维基中关于 **X** 的所有内容”  
- “比较 wikiA 和 wikiB 对 **Y** 的看法”  
- “这个问题我应该查阅哪个维基百科？”  
- “扫描我的工作空间”  
- “运行完整的工作区 lint”  
- “注意：用户更喜欢按时间线分割维基”  
- “wikiA 中的 **X** 也存在于 wikiB 中——添加一个链接”  
- “升级工作区/迁移到最新规范/检查工作区版本”

**不适用**：单wiki摄取/查询/lint（由**yzr-llm-wiki-management**处理）；工作区/wiki 元数据 CRUD（由工作区 CLI 处理）；云协作 wiki（由 **yzr-outline-wiki** 处理）。

yzr95924/yzr-skill/yzr-md-to-html.title: yzr-md-to-html
yzr95924/yzr-skill/yzr-md-to-html.description:

自包含、双击即可在浏览器打开的本地 HTML 文件时使用本 skill：默认深色阅读主题 + 侧边栏目录
TOC + 离线代码高亮，公式 / Mermaid 按需挂 CDN，支持 `--template` 自定义模板。

打开看的网页" / "把 notes/ 目录下的 .md 批量转成 html" / "转成 html 后用 agent-html-drop
上传分享"。只要用户明确要"本地 .md → 自包含 HTML 文件"的单向转换——即使没提 skill 名，
也务必使用本 skill。

的在线网页）、Markdown → PDF 或其它格式、HTML → Markdown 反向、实时预览 / 在线编辑器、

yzy1996/english-writing/academic-paper-p.title: academic-paper-polish
yzy1996/english-writing/academic-paper-p.description: Polish and improve English writing for academic/research papers, especially in CS and ML fields. Use this skill whenever the user asks to improve, revise, or polish academic writing; wants sentence templates or phrase suggestions for paper sections (abstract, introduction, related work, method, experiment, conclusion, rebuttal); needs better vocabulary or synonyms for paper writing; asks how to phrase results, describe methods, or present findings academically; wants help writing any part of a research paper. Also activate when the user pastes a paragraph and asks to "make it better", "make it more academic", or similar in a research context.

用于创作文章、写内容、做选题研究并发布到知乎/小红书/公众号。

z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill/humanizer-cn.title: humanizer-cn
z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill/humanizer-cn.description:
识别并消除中文文本中的 AI 生成痕迹，使文章更自然、更像人类创作。
基于中文语境的 AI 写作特征检测，包括套话、过度修饰、机械结构等。
参考 Wikipedia "Signs of AI writing" 指南，并针对中文进行本地化。

z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill/image-proces.title: image-processing
z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill/image-proces.description:

zai-org/glm-skills/glmv-grounding.title: glmv-grounding
zai-org/glm-skills/glmv-grounding.description: A skill that uses GLM-V native grounding capabilities for coordinate conversion, bounding-box visualization, and more. GLM-V native grounding can locate any target specified by the prompt in an image and output relative coordinates normalized to 0-1000 based on image size. Coordinate formats include 2D bounding box (default), 2D points, and 3D bounding box. GLM-V also supports spatiotemporal localization and tracking of multiple prompt-specified targets in videos, outputting 2D bounding boxes per second.

zaidmukaddam/skills/pr-discipline.title: pr-discipline
zaidmukaddam/skills/pr-discipline.description: Shape a change so it can actually be reviewed, not just merged. Decide before writing code whether the work is one pull request or a stack of them, keep the title and body describing the diff as it exists right now, not the plan you started with, group commits by concern in dependency order, give every review comment an explicit disposition, and only call a change ready after re-checking the real state of checks and threads instead of trusting that a push or a reply worked. Use this whenever a change is being opened, split, described, updated, or readied as a pull request or merge request, including deciding how many PRs a piece of work needs, planning or syncing a stack of dependent branches, writing or refreshing a PR description, shaping commit history before requesting review, triaging review feedback, or judging whether a PR is actually mergeable. Reach for it any time work is about to leave a branch and become something someone else has to read.

Reach for it any time work is about to leave a branch and become something someone else has to read.
zaidmukaddam/skills/pr-discipline.descriptionCn: 塑造变更，以便实际上可以对其进行审查，而不仅仅是合并。在编写代码之前决定工作是一个拉取请求还是一堆请求，保留当前存在的描述差异的标题和正文，而不是您开始的计划，按依赖顺序按关注点对提交进行分组，为每个评论评论提供明确的处置，并且仅在重新检查检查和线程的真实状态后才调用更改就绪，而不是相信推送或回复有效。每当打开、拆分、描述、更新或准备作为拉取请求或合并请求进行更改时，请使用此功能，包括确定一项工作需要多少 PR，规划或同步一堆依赖分支，编写或刷新 PR 描述，在请求审查之前调整提交历史记录，对审查反馈进行分类，或判断 PR 是否实际上可合并。每当作品即将离开分支并成为其他人必须阅读的东西时，就伸手去拿它。
