zakariaf/flutter-skills/ci-pipeline-and-.descriptionCn: 实施精益的 GitHub Actions Flutter CI，其中每个门都映射到一个命名的发布阻止合约 - 固定运行程序 + subosito/flutter-action@v2 工具链、dart 格式 --set-exit-if-changed、flutteranalysis --fatal-infos、build_runner 和漂移模式新鲜度 (git diff --exit-code)、flutter test --test-randomize-ordering-seed random、静态导入/禁止字符串 grep 捕获运行时不能做到的，覆盖作为报告从不-a-gate，向上谎言固定，验证从不祝福黄金（CI 中没有 --update-goldens），以及 CI 无法证明的诚实陈述（音频、真实字体、设备上行为）。在编辑 .github/workflows/*.yml、添加或删除作业或步骤、连接 codegen/schema/format/analyze/coverage 门、在 test/policy 或 tool/ 下编写基于 grep 的策略测试或门脚本、固定操作版本或声称 CI 证明了它不能证明的东西时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/codegen-and-tool.title: codegen-and-toolchain
zakariaf/flutter-skills/codegen-and-tool.description: Enforces a deterministic build_runner codegen discipline: run one pinned `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` pass BEFORE `flutter analyze` (never after), fence every builder with `generate_for:` globs in a per-package `build.yaml`, make one deliberate commit-vs-gitignore decision for `*.g.dart`/`*.freezed.dart`/`*.drift.dart` and back it with the matching CI gate (freshness diff if committed, codegen-first if gitignored), mirror the generated-file globs into the analyzer AND coverage excludes, pin the SDK, and never hand-edit generated output. Use when editing build.yaml, analysis_options.yaml, pubspec.yaml, .gitignore, .gitattributes, or CI workflows; wiring drift_dev/freezed/json_serializable/riverpod_generator/ gen-l10n/mockito codegen; fixing "missing part file", "undefined class _$Foo", or "conflicting outputs" errors; deciding whether to commit generated code; or scoping builders so one edit does not regenerate everything.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/codegen-and-tool.descriptionEn: Enforces a deterministic build_runner codegen discipline: run one pinned `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` pass BEFORE `flutter analyze` (never after), fence every builder with `generate_for:` globs in a per-package `build.yaml`, make one deliberate commit-vs-gitignore decision for `*.g.dart`/`*.freezed.dart`/`*.drift.dart` and back it with the matching CI gate (freshness diff if committed, codegen-first if gitignored), mirror the generated-file globs into the analyzer AND coverage excludes, pin the SDK, and never hand-edit generated output. Use when editing build.yaml, analysis_options.yaml, pubspec.yaml, .gitignore, .gitattributes, or CI workflows; wiring drift_dev/freezed/json_serializable/riverpod_generator/ gen-l10n/mockito codegen; fixing "missing part file", "undefined class _$Foo", or "conflicting outputs" errors; deciding whether to commit generated code; or scoping builders so one edit does not regenerate everything.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/codegen-and-tool.descriptionCn: 强制执行确定性的 build_runner codegen 规则：在 `flutteranalyze` 之前运行一个固定的 `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` 传递（永远不会之后），在每个包 `build.yaml` 中使用 `generate_for:` 全局对象围住每个构建器，为每个包做出一个慎重的提交与 gitignore 决定`*.g.dart`/`*.freezed.dart`/`*.drift.dart` 并使用匹配的 CI 门支持它（如果提交了新鲜度差异，如果 gitignored 则代码生成优先），将生成的文件 glob 镜像到分析器中并覆盖排除，固定 SDK，并且永远不要手动编辑生成的输出。在编辑 build.yaml、analysis_options.yaml、pubspec.yaml、.gitignore、.gitattributes 或 CI 工作流程时使用；接线drift_dev/freezed/json_serialized/riverpod_generator/gen-l10n/mockito codegen；修复“缺少部分文件”、“未定义的类 _$Foo”或“输出冲突”错误；决定是否提交生成的代码；或确定构建器的范围，以便一次编辑不会重新生成所有内容。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/custom-canvas-an.title: custom-canvas-and-gestures
zakariaf/flutter-skills/custom-canvas-an.description: Enforces CustomPainter/Canvas discipline — the View/Painter/Scene split with a dumb painter fed one immutable Scene value type, shouldRepaint as a single value compare kept strictly separate from the AnimationController-as-repaint animation path, one shared affine transform read by BOTH painter and hit-tester (toCanvas/toLogical exact inverses, never re-derive scale), geometry hit-testing (integer lattice or rasterized region-ID buffer, never Path.contains), zero-allocation paint(), gesture-as-pure-translator emitting a typed command to a Notifier (never mutating in the handler), ExcludeSemantics + sibling Semantics speaking display values with redundant non-colour encoding, measured TextPainter fitting, first-party RoundedSuperellipseBorder, physical-pixel hairlines, and Directional-only geometry. Use when writing or reviewing a CustomPainter/CustomPaint, gestures on a canvas, tap/drag hit-testing, canvas animation, measured text fitting, or Semantics over custom-drawn pixels.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/custom-canvas-an.descriptionEn: Enforces CustomPainter/Canvas discipline — the View/Painter/Scene split with a dumb painter fed one immutable Scene value type, shouldRepaint as a single value compare kept strictly separate from the AnimationController-as-repaint animation path, one shared affine transform read by BOTH painter and hit-tester (toCanvas/toLogical exact inverses, never re-derive scale), geometry hit-testing (integer lattice or rasterized region-ID buffer, never Path.contains), zero-allocation paint(), gesture-as-pure-translator emitting a typed command to a Notifier (never mutating in the handler), ExcludeSemantics + sibling Semantics speaking display values with redundant non-colour encoding, measured TextPainter fitting, first-party RoundedSuperellipseBorder, physical-pixel hairlines, and Directional-only geometry. Use when writing or reviewing a CustomPainter/CustomPaint, gestures on a canvas, tap/drag hit-testing, canvas animation, measured text fitting, or Semantics over custom-drawn pixels.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/custom-canvas-an.descriptionCn: 强制执行 CustomPainter/Canvas 规则 - 视图/画家/场景与哑画家馈送一个不可变的场景值类型，shouldRepaint 作为单个值比较与动画控制器作为重画动画路径严格分开，由画家和命中测试器读取的一个共享仿射变换（toCanvas/toLogical 精确反转，从不重新导出比例），几何命中测试（整数晶格或光栅化区域 ID 缓冲区，从不） Path.contains）、零分配 Paint()、纯粹手势翻译器向通知程序发出键入的命令（永远不会在处理程序中发生变化）、ExcludeSemantics + 同级语义语言显示具有冗余非颜色编码的值、测量的 TextPainter 拟合、第一方 RoundedSuperellipseBorder、物理像素细线和仅方向几何图形。在编写或检查 CustomPainter/CustomPaint、画布上的手势、点击/拖动命中测试、画布动画、测量的文本拟合或自定义绘制像素的语义时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/dart3-idioms-and.title: dart3-idioms-and-coding-standards
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dart3-idioms-and.description: Enforces which Dart 3 construct each declaration earns — sealed class + exhaustive switch with no `default:`/`case _:`, the three class modifiers (`sealed`/`final`/`abstract interface class`) and skip the rest, records as intra-layer tuples only, immutable value types (`final` fields, `const` ctor, value equality) hand-rolled when trivial and `freezed` when boilerplate dominates, explicit stable identity, total non-throwing domain functions, make-illegal-states-unrepresentable, and firm method/build/file/nesting complexity limits (the single-source-of-truth table other skills cite) — while banning `late`/`!`/`dynamic` honesty dodges. Use when authoring or reviewing any Dart type or declaration: class vs enum vs record vs typedef, hand-rolled vs `freezed`, adding a `switch`/`if-case`, writing `copyWith` or `==`/`hashCode`, deciding identity, keeping a domain function total, or hitting a length/nesting limit.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dart3-idioms-and.descriptionEn: Enforces which Dart 3 construct each declaration earns — sealed class + exhaustive switch with no `default:`/`case _:`, the three class modifiers (`sealed`/`final`/`abstract interface class`) and skip the rest, records as intra-layer tuples only, immutable value types (`final` fields, `const` ctor, value equality) hand-rolled when trivial and `freezed` when boilerplate dominates, explicit stable identity, total non-throwing domain functions, make-illegal-states-unrepresentable, and firm method/build/file/nesting complexity limits (the single-source-of-truth table other skills cite) — while banning `late`/`!`/`dynamic` honesty dodges. Use when authoring or reviewing any Dart type or declaration: class vs enum vs record vs typedef, hand-rolled vs `freezed`, adding a `switch`/`if-case`, writing `copyWith` or `==`/`hashCode`, deciding identity, keeping a domain function total, or hitting a length/nesting limit.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dart3-idioms-and.descriptionCn: 强制执行 Dart 3 构造每个声明的方式 — 密封类 + 详尽的开关，没有 `default:`/`case _:`，三个类修饰符（`sealed`/`final`/`抽象接口类`）并跳过其余部分，仅记录为层内元组，不可变值类型（`final` 字段、`const` ctor、值相等）在琐碎时手动滚动，在样板占主导地位时手动滚动，显式稳定身份、总的非抛出域函数、使非法状态无法表示以及严格的方法/构建/文件/嵌套复杂性限制（其他技能引用的单一事实来源表）——同时禁止“迟到”/“！”/“动态”诚实回避。在创作或审查任何 Dart 类型或声明时使用：类 vs 枚举 vs 记录 vs typedef、手卷 vs `freezed`、添加 `switch`/`if-case`、编写 `copyWith` 或 `==`/`hashCode`、决定身份、保留域函数总数或达到长度/嵌套限制。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/dartdoc-conventi.title: dartdoc-conventions
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dartdoc-conventi.description: Enforces Effective-Dart documentation on the public surface — a `///` doc on every public class/method/getter/field/typedef, a one-sentence standalone summary that says WHY plus units/ranges/nullability/throws/side-effects (never a restatement of the name), verb-phrase method docs, "Whether…" boolean getters, `[bracket]` cross-links, one `library;` doc per exported barrel, in-body `//` that explains why not what, and the enforced invariant restated at its enforcement point — backed by `public_member_api_docs` and `dangling_library_doc_comments` as analyzer errors. Use when adding or reviewing a public API, a Notifier/provider, a Service interface, a sealed Failure, a value type, or preparing a package's dartdoc.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dartdoc-conventi.descriptionEn: Enforces Effective-Dart documentation on the public surface — a `///` doc on every public class/method/getter/field/typedef, a one-sentence standalone summary that says WHY plus units/ranges/nullability/throws/side-effects (never a restatement of the name), verb-phrase method docs, "Whether…" boolean getters, `[bracket]` cross-links, one `library;` doc per exported barrel, in-body `//` that explains why not what, and the enforced invariant restated at its enforcement point — backed by `public_member_api_docs` and `dangling_library_doc_comments` as analyzer errors. Use when adding or reviewing a public API, a Notifier/provider, a Service interface, a sealed Failure, a value type, or preparing a package's dartdoc.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dartdoc-conventi.descriptionCn: 在公共表面上强制执行有效的 Dart 文档 - 每个公共类/方法/getter/field/typedef 上的一个 `///` 文档，一个单句独立摘要，说明为什么加上单位/范围/可空性/抛出/副作用（从不重述名称），动词短语方法文档，“是否...”布尔 getters，“[括号]”交叉链接，一个“库；”每个导出桶的文档，体内“//”解释为什么而不是什么，以及在其执行点重述的强制不变式 - 由“public_member_api_docs”和“dangling_library_doc_comments”支持作为分析器错误。在添加或查看公共 API、通知程序/提供程序、服务接口、密封故障、值类型或准备包的 dartdoc 时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/data-export-and-.title: data-export-and-restore
zakariaf/flutter-skills/data-export-and-.description: Enforces user-facing data portability in an offline-first app — backup/restore (exact, machine round-trippable) kept strictly separate from export/report (human, lossy, never a restore source); a versioned envelope carrying formatVersion, schemaVersion, appVersion, exportedAtUtc and a payload checksum so a restore refuses a file from a newer app instead of corrupting the database; restore as an all-or-nothing import into a staging database swapped in only after validation; canonical values in machine formats (integer minor units, SI integers, ISO-8601 UTC, stable ids) and never localized numerals; RFC 4180 CSV quoting plus the =/+/-/@ formula-injection escape; streaming writes published by atomic rename; the share sheet behind an injected Gateway; and an export→import→export round-trip test on a hostile fixture. Use when adding or changing export, backup, import, restore, share, or CSV/JSON/PDF output, writing an import validator or merge-vs-replace policy, or handling a picked file.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/data-export-and-.descriptionEn: Enforces user-facing data portability in an offline-first app — backup/restore (exact, machine round-trippable) kept strictly separate from export/report (human, lossy, never a restore source); a versioned envelope carrying formatVersion, schemaVersion, appVersion, exportedAtUtc and a payload checksum so a restore refuses a file from a newer app instead of corrupting the database; restore as an all-or-nothing import into a staging database swapped in only after validation; canonical values in machine formats (integer minor units, SI integers, ISO-8601 UTC, stable ids) and never localized numerals; RFC 4180 CSV quoting plus the =/+/-/@ formula-injection escape; streaming writes published by atomic rename; the share sheet behind an injected Gateway; and an export→import→export round-trip test on a hostile fixture. Use when adding or changing export, backup, import, restore, share, or CSV/JSON/PDF output, writing an import validator or merge-vs-replace policy, or handling a picked file.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/data-export-and-.descriptionCn: 在离线优先的应用程序中强制执行面向用户的数据可移植性——备份/恢复（精确，机器可往返）与导出/报告严格分开（人工，有损，绝不是恢复源）；带有 formatVersion、schemaVersion、appVersion、exportedAtUtc 和有效负载校验和的版本化信封，因此恢复会拒绝来自较新应用程序的文件，而不是损坏数据库；作为全有或全无导入恢复到仅在验证后交换的临时数据库；机器格式的规范值（整数小单位、SI 整数、ISO-8601 UTC、稳定 ID）和从未本地化的数字； RFC 4180 CSV 引用加上 =/+/-/@ 公式注入转义；通过原子重命名发布流式写入；注入网关后面的共享表；以及对敌对装置进行导出→导入→导出往返测试。在添加或更改导出、备份、导入、恢复、共享或 CSV/JSON/PDF 输出、编写导入验证器或合并与替换策略或处理所选文件时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/dependency-hygie.title: dependency-hygiene
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dependency-hygie.description: Enforces pubspec/lock discipline — caret ranges in pubspec.yaml with a committed pubspec.lock as the only pin, a separately-recorded SDK version string, a version-pinned very_good_analysis include (whose missing file fails default analyze, or silently drops the ruleset where warnings are non-fatal), transitive-tree auditing before adding a package, a dependency gate that refuses network/telemetry/crash/ads/heavy-transitive deps by policy, and vendoring any bus-factor-1 native plugin behind an interface into third_party/. Use when running dart pub add/get/upgrade/outdated/deps, editing pubspec.yaml or pubspec.lock, bumping the Flutter/Dart SDK, choosing or rejecting a new dependency, removing a package, or auditing what a dependency drags in.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dependency-hygie.descriptionEn: Enforces pubspec/lock discipline — caret ranges in pubspec.yaml with a committed pubspec.lock as the only pin, a separately-recorded SDK version string, a version-pinned very_good_analysis include (whose missing file fails default analyze, or silently drops the ruleset where warnings are non-fatal), transitive-tree auditing before adding a package, a dependency gate that refuses network/telemetry/crash/ads/heavy-transitive deps by policy, and vendoring any bus-factor-1 native plugin behind an interface into third_party/. Use when running dart pub add/get/upgrade/outdated/deps, editing pubspec.yaml or pubspec.lock, bumping the Flutter/Dart SDK, choosing or rejecting a new dependency, removing a package, or auditing what a dependency drags in.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dependency-hygie.descriptionCn: 强制执行 pubspec/lock 规则 - pubspec.yaml 中的插入符范围，以提交的 pubspec.lock 作为唯一的 pin，单独记录的 SDK 版本字符串，版本固定的 very_good_analysis 包含（其丢失的文件默认分析失败，或者默默地删除警告非致命的规则集），添加包之前的传递树审核，拒绝网络/遥测/崩溃/广告/重传递依赖的依赖门策略，并将接口后面的任何总线因子 1 本机插件供应到third_party/。在运行 dart pub add/get/upgrade/outdated/deps、编辑 pubspec.yaml 或 pubspec.lock、碰撞 Flutter/Dart SDK、选择或拒绝新依赖项、删除包或审核依赖项拖入的内容时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/design-system-st.title: design-system-structure
zakariaf/flutter-skills/design-system-st.description: Structures a Flutter design system as tokens→theme→modifiers→shapes with two-tier tokens (primitives named by measured value, semantic slots named by role) exposed through a ThemeExtension read via an asserting of(context); hand-authors both light and dark ColorScheme instead of ColorScheme.fromSeed, keeps every raw color/hex/Colors./Curves./Duration/BorderRadius/fontSize inside lib/theme/ behind a no-raw-values gate, collapses animation to zero under reduced motion, restores the persisted theme before first paint, bundles fonts (never google_fonts/dynamic_color), and derives each stateful meaning's supporting color last so color is never its sole signal. Use when creating or editing ThemeData/ThemeExtension/ColorScheme, adding or renaming a design token, wiring theme injection or theme-mode persistence, reaching for fromSeed/dynamic_color/google_fonts/FontVariation, structuring a theme/ or DesignSystem/ folder, or reviewing any widget that renders a color, radius, duration, or font.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/design-system-st.descriptionEn: Structures a Flutter design system as tokens→theme→modifiers→shapes with two-tier tokens (primitives named by measured value, semantic slots named by role) exposed through a ThemeExtension read via an asserting of(context); hand-authors both light and dark ColorScheme instead of ColorScheme.fromSeed, keeps every raw color/hex/Colors./Curves./Duration/BorderRadius/fontSize inside lib/theme/ behind a no-raw-values gate, collapses animation to zero under reduced motion, restores the persisted theme before first paint, bundles fonts (never google_fonts/dynamic_color), and derives each stateful meaning's supporting color last so color is never its sole signal. Use when creating or editing ThemeData/ThemeExtension/ColorScheme, adding or renaming a design token, wiring theme injection or theme-mode persistence, reaching for fromSeed/dynamic_color/google_fonts/FontVariation, structuring a theme/ or DesignSystem/ folder, or reviewing any widget that renders a color, radius, duration, or font.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/design-system-st.descriptionCn: 将 Flutter 设计系统构造为令牌→主题→修饰符→形状，其中具有两层令牌（由测量值命名的基元，由角色命名的语义槽），通过（上下文）的断言读取的 ThemeExtension 公开；手工创作浅色和深色 ColorScheme 而不是 ColorScheme.fromSeed，将每个原始颜色/hex/Colors./Curves./Duration/BorderRadius/fontSize 保留在 lib/theme/ 内的无原始值门后面，在减少运动下将动画折叠为零，在第一次绘制之前恢复持久主题，捆绑字体（从不 google_fonts/dynamic_color），并派生每个有状态含义的支持颜色放在最后，因此颜色永远不是其唯一的信号。在创建或编辑 ThemeData/ThemeExtension/ColorScheme、添加或重命名设计令牌、连接主题注入或主题模式持久性、访问 fromSeed/dynamic_color/google_fonts/FontVariation、构造 theme/ 或 DesignSystem/ 文件夹或查看呈现颜色、半径、持续时间或字体的任何小部件时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/error-handling-t.title: error-handling-typed-results
zakariaf/flutter-skills/error-handling-t.description: Enforces a typed-error spine — a hand-rolled sealed Result<T,F> plus one per-boundary sealed Failure carrying a stable code and typed params (never a localized string), returned instead of thrown; recoverable failures are values, only bugs throw. Convert-at-boundary catches narrowly with an on-clause and logs the original error+stack BEFORE returning a typed Failure; call sites switch exhaustively with no default:; the taxonomy of what the global error net (FlutterError.onError + PlatformDispatcher.onError, installed by app-startup-and-bootstrap) routes into, plus Isolate.run re-wrapping; mechanism selection (Error vs assert vs Exception vs sealed outcome) and @useResult; and a never-lose-data layer (one-transaction-per-mutation, debounced autosave drafts, optimistic soft-delete/Undo). Use when writing result.dart/failures.dart, a try/catch or sealed-switch default:, wiring bootstrap handlers, a repository/service/DAO boundary, or transactions, drafts, or soft-delete/Undo.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/error-handling-t.descriptionEn: Enforces a typed-error spine — a hand-rolled sealed Result<T,F> plus one per-boundary sealed Failure carrying a stable code and typed params (never a localized string), returned instead of thrown; recoverable failures are values, only bugs throw. Convert-at-boundary catches narrowly with an on-clause and logs the original error+stack BEFORE returning a typed Failure; call sites switch exhaustively with no default:; the taxonomy of what the global error net (FlutterError.onError + PlatformDispatcher.onError, installed by app-startup-and-bootstrap) routes into, plus Isolate.run re-wrapping; mechanism selection (Error vs assert vs Exception vs sealed outcome) and @useResult; and a never-lose-data layer (one-transaction-per-mutation, debounced autosave drafts, optimistic soft-delete/Undo). Use when writing result.dart/failures.dart, a try/catch or sealed-switch default:, wiring bootstrap handlers, a repository/service/DAO boundary, or transactions, drafts, or soft-delete/Undo.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/error-handling-t.descriptionCn: 强制执行类型化错误脊柱 - 一个手工滚动的密封 Result<T,F> 加上一个每个边界密封的 Failure，携带稳定代码和类型化参数（绝不是本地化字符串），返回而不是抛出；可恢复的故障是值，只有错误才会抛出。 Convert-at-boundary 使用 on 子句捕获并在返回类型化失败之前记录原始错误+堆栈；调用站点完全切换，没有默认值：；全局错误网（FlutterError.onError + PlatformDispatcher.onError，由 app-startup-and-bootstrap 安装）路由到的分类，加上 Isolate.run 重新包装；机制选择（错误、断言、异常、密封结果）和@useResult；以及永不丢失数据层（每个突变一个事务、去抖自动保存草稿、乐观软删除/撤消）。在编写 result.dart/failures.dart、try/catch 或密封开关默认值时使用：连接引导处理程序、存储库/服务/DAO 边界或事务、草稿或软删除/撤消。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-architec.title: flutter-architecture
zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-architec.description: Enforces a right-sized feature-first layered MVVM Flutter architecture — features are folders and cross-cutting foundations become packages only when a compile wall earns it, a strict downward-only dependency DAG, dumb Views over one Notifier/AsyncNotifier ViewModel per feature, repositories as the single source of truth and single write path returning immutable domain values, abstractions only where something genuinely can't run in a test, and Riverpod 3.x as the one context-free DI+state mechanism (no get_it/injectable/package:provider container). Use when creating a Flutter feature or file, deciding folder-vs-package or where a class belongs, naming a Screen/Notifier/Repository/Service, wiring providers or a composition-root/bootstrap.dart, adding a use-case/domain layer, resisting over-engineering on a small app, or reviewing whether a change respects the layer boundaries.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-architec.descriptionEn: Enforces a right-sized feature-first layered MVVM Flutter architecture — features are folders and cross-cutting foundations become packages only when a compile wall earns it, a strict downward-only dependency DAG, dumb Views over one Notifier/AsyncNotifier ViewModel per feature, repositories as the single source of truth and single write path returning immutable domain values, abstractions only where something genuinely can't run in a test, and Riverpod 3.x as the one context-free DI+state mechanism (no get_it/injectable/package:provider container). Use when creating a Flutter feature or file, deciding folder-vs-package or where a class belongs, naming a Screen/Notifier/Repository/Service, wiring providers or a composition-root/bootstrap.dart, adding a use-case/domain layer, resisting over-engineering on a small app, or reviewing whether a change respects the layer boundaries.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-architec.descriptionCn: 强制实施大小合适的功能优先分层 MVVM Flutter 架构 - 功能是文件夹，横切基础只有在编译墙获得它时才成为包，严格的向下依赖 DAG，每个功能一个 Notifier/AsyncNotifier ViewModel 上的哑视图，存储库作为单一事实来源和返回不可变域值的单一写入路径，仅在测试中真正无法运行的地方进行抽象，以及 Riverpod 3.x 作为一个上下文无关的DI+状态机制（无 get_it/injectable/package:provider 容器）。在创建 Flutter 功能或文件、决定文件夹与包或类所属位置、命名 Screen/Notifier/Repository/Service、连接提供程序或合成根/bootstrap.dart、添加用例/域层、抵制小型应用程序上的过度工程或检查更改是否尊重层边界时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-conventi.description: The repo front-door for a Flutter/Dart app — the cross-cutting house rules (feature-first layered MVVM, immutable state with a single write path, Riverpod 3.x for state + DI, typed Result/Failure errors, dumb widgets, injected side effects, complexity limits) plus a routing table that sends each task to its deep-dive skill and a recommended feature build order. zakariaf/flutter-skills/forms-and-input.title: forms-and-input
zakariaf/flutter-skills/forms-and-input.description: Enforces Form + GlobalKey<FormState> with TextFormField whose sync validator returns a localized String? (never a hardcoded literal), AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction, async availability checks moved OUT of the sync validator into a debounced Riverpod Notifier that surfaces errors through state, FocusNode/TextInputAction/onFieldSubmitted traversal, keyboardType/textCapitalization/autofillHints/TextInputFormatter, mandatory TextEditingController/FocusNode disposal, submit-enabled derived from validity (not stored), and scoped rebuilds so a keystroke never rebuilds the whole form. zakariaf/flutter-skills/i18n-rtl-l10n.title: i18n-rtl-l10n
zakariaf/flutter-skills/i18n-rtl-l10n.description: Enforces the gen-l10n/ARB localization contract: every user-facing string routed through AppLocalizations from a template app_en.arb with key + placeholder parity across locales, nullable-getter:false so a missing key is a compile error, ICU plural/select over string concatenation, Directional-only geometry (EdgeInsetsDirectional, AlignmentDirectional, TextAlign.start, Icons.adaptive) for correct-by-construction RTL, one FSI/PDI bidi-isolation helper for mixed-script runs, per-locale NumberFormat with a pinned numbering system fed to chrome and canvas alike, canonical UTC-epoch + ASCII storage with calendar/numeral projection only at render, and normalize-to-ASCII before any numeric parse. Use when adding or translating an ARB key, building an RTL screen, formatting or parsing dates/numbers/numerals, wiring l10n.yaml, AppLocalizations, or MaterialApp localization delegates, isolating technical IDs like an account or order reference, or touching app_*.arb.

zakariaf/flutter-skills/i18n-rtl-l10n.descriptionCn: 强制执行 gen-l10n/ARB 本地化合同：每个面向用户的字符串从模板 app_en.arb 通过 AppLocalizations 路由，并具有跨语言环境的键 + 占位符奇偶校验，nullable-getter:false 因此缺少键是编译错误，ICU 复数/选择字符串连接，仅限方向几何（EdgeInsetsDirectional、AlignmentDirectional、TextAlign.start、Icons.adaptive）以进行正确构建RTL，一个用于混合脚本运行的 FSI/PDI 双向隔离帮助程序，每个区域设置的 NumberFormat 以及馈送到 chrome 和 canvas 等的固定编号系统，规范的 UTC 纪元 + ASCII 存储，仅在渲染时进行日历/数字投影，并在任何数字解析之前标准化为 ASCII。在添加或翻译 ARB 密钥、构建 RTL 屏幕、格式化或解析日期/数字/数字、连接 l10n.yaml、AppLocalizations 或 MaterialApp 本地化委托、隔离帐户或订单引用等技术 ID 或触摸 app_*.arb 时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/lint-and-style-c.description: Enforces a strict analysis_options.yaml built on very_good_analysis with strict-casts/strict-raw-types, a fixed set of silence-producing bug classes promoted to error (unawaited_futures, discarded_futures, empty_catches, use_build_context_synchronously, cancel_subscriptions, close_sinks, avoid_dynamic_calls, exhaustive_cases, avoid_print), dart format as the sole whitespace authority, generated-file excludes mirrored to coverage, and line-scoped-only suppression discipline; teaches the version-pinned-include trap (a missing include silently disables all rules), the errors-only-re-ranks-vs-linter-enables mechanic, and the sealed-switch analyze-vs-compile gap. zakariaf/flutter-skills/local-notificati.title: local-notifications-scheduler
zakariaf/flutter-skills/local-notificati.description: Enforces an on-device reminder engine where the local database is the only source of truth and the OS pending-notification set is a disposable cache reconciled through one idempotent syncNotifications() entrypoint; keeps flutter_local_notifications behind a single NotificationGateway port, all scheduling math pure and Clock-injected, recurring schedules stored as wall-clock + recurrence rule (never UTC instants) and resolved to a TZDateTime in tz.local for DST correctness, inexact-alarm default with SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM as an opt-in, iOS ~64-cap budgeting, isolate-safe @pragma('vm:entry-point') tap handlers, and Android boot re-arm. Use when writing or editing notification_gateway.dart, fln_notification_gateway.dart, reminder_scheduler.dart, recurrence_rule.dart, syncNotifications, zonedSchedule wiring, snooze or mark-done re-anchoring, or diagnosing missed or wrong-hour notifications.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/local-notificati.descriptionEn: Enforces an on-device reminder engine where the local database is the only source of truth and the OS pending-notification set is a disposable cache reconciled through one idempotent syncNotifications() entrypoint; keeps flutter_local_notifications behind a single NotificationGateway port, all scheduling math pure and Clock-injected, recurring schedules stored as wall-clock + recurrence rule (never UTC instants) and resolved to a TZDateTime in tz.local for DST correctness, inexact-alarm default with SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM as an opt-in, iOS ~64-cap budgeting, isolate-safe @pragma('vm:entry-point') tap handlers, and Android boot re-arm. Use when writing or editing notification_gateway.dart, fln_notification_gateway.dart, reminder_scheduler.dart, recurrence_rule.dart, syncNotifications, zonedSchedule wiring, snooze or mark-done re-anchoring, or diagnosing missed or wrong-hour notifications.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/local-notificati.descriptionCn: 强制执行设备上提醒引擎，其中本地数据库是唯一的事实来源，操作系统待处理通知集是通过一个幂等的syncNotifications()入口点协调的一次性缓存；将 flutter_local_notifications 保留在单个 NotificationGateway 端口后面，所有调度数学都是纯的和时钟注入的，循环调度存储为挂钟 + 循环规则（绝不是 UTC 时刻）并解析为 tz.local 中的 TZDateTime 以确保 DST 正确性，不精确警报默认使用 SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM 作为选择加入，iOS ~64 上限预算，隔离安全@pragma('vm:entry-point') 点击处理程序，以及 Android 启动重新启动。在编写或编辑 notification_gateway.dart、fln_notification_gateway.dart、reminder_scheduler.dart、recurrence_rule.dart、syncNotifications、zonedSchedule 连接、暂停或标记完成重新锚定或诊断错过或错误时间通知时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/motion-and-hapti.title: motion-and-haptics
zakariaf/flutter-skills/motion-and-hapti.description: Enforces designed interaction feedback instead of the framework default — every committing interaction acknowledged in the same frame, motion that decorates state but never IS the state (the end state is identical with animations off), a named catalog of moments each declaring its trigger, duration role, haptic slot and reduced-motion fallback at design time, haptics as a HapticTheme event-to-intensity map fired exactly once on the commit frame (never per animation frame, never per coalesced input, never heavyImpact for an error) behind one central toggle, every animation interruptible so a tap resolves it to its end state, a bounded celebration that plays once and never loops or blocks input, an explicit stop condition on every repeating animation (off-route, backgrounded, reduced motion), and feedback on more than one channel so haptics and sound survive reduced motion. Use when adding or tuning an animation, a success or error state, a haptic, a celebration, or a screen transition.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/motion-and-hapti.descriptionEn: Enforces designed interaction feedback instead of the framework default — every committing interaction acknowledged in the same frame, motion that decorates state but never IS the state (the end state is identical with animations off), a named catalog of moments each declaring its trigger, duration role, haptic slot and reduced-motion fallback at design time, haptics as a HapticTheme event-to-intensity map fired exactly once on the commit frame (never per animation frame, never per coalesced input, never heavyImpact for an error) behind one central toggle, every animation interruptible so a tap resolves it to its end state, a bounded celebration that plays once and never loops or blocks input, an explicit stop condition on every repeating animation (off-route, backgrounded, reduced motion), and feedback on more than one channel so haptics and sound survive reduced motion. Use when adding or tuning an animation, a success or error state, a haptic, a celebration, or a screen transition.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/motion-and-hapti.descriptionCn: 强制执行设计的交互反馈而不是框架默认值 - 每个在同一帧中确认的提交交互、装饰状态但绝不是状态的运动（最终状态与动画关闭相同）、每个时刻的命名目录，每个时刻都在设计时声明其触发器、持续时间角色、触觉槽和简化运动后备，触觉作为 HapticTheme 事件到强度映射在提交帧上仅触发一次（从不按动画帧，从不按合并输入，从不重影响）一个中央开关后面的每个动画都可以中断，这样点击就可以将其解决为最终状态，一种播放一次并且从不循环或阻止输入的有限庆祝，每个重复动画的明确停止条件（偏离路线，背景，减少运动），以及多个通道的反馈，以便触觉和声音在减少的运动中幸存。在添加或调整动画、成功或错误状态、触觉、庆祝或屏幕转换时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/persistence-drif.title: persistence-drift

zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-goldens-reba.title: run-goldens-rebaseline
zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-goldens-reba.description: Runs the golden re-baselining ritual — the one sanctioned way committed reference images are overwritten. Enforces the order: land and green the non-golden geometry, contrast and a11y tests FIRST, re-baseline only in the pinned blessing environment that produced the committed images, with loadAppFonts() so nothing renders in Ahem, via `flutter test --update-goldens --tags golden` (never in CI, never to make a red pipeline green), then inspect every changed PNG by eye, delete the orphans left by renamed or removed tests, land the images as their own commit naming why they moved, and prove it by re-running the suite WITHOUT the flag. Manual, side-effecting workflow. Use when a deliberate visual change breaks matchesGoldenFile, when adding or renaming a golden test, or when someone reaches for --update-goldens.

zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-goldens-reba.descriptionCn: 运行黄金重新基线仪式 - 覆盖提交的参考图像的一种认可方式。强制执行顺序：首先对非金色几何体、对比度和 a11y 测试进行着陆和绿化，仅在生成提交图像的固定祝福环境中重新设置基线，使用 loadAppFonts()，这样通过“flutter test --update-goldens --tags Golden”，在 Ahem 中不会渲染任何内容（切勿在 CI 中，切勿将红色管道设为绿色），然后通过肉眼检查每个更改的 PNG，删除由重命名或删除的测试留下的孤儿，将图像着陆为他们自己的提交命名了他们移动的原因，并通过在没有标志的情况下重新运行套件来证明这一点。手动的、有副作用的工作流程。当故意的视觉更改破坏 matchesGoldenFile 时、添加或重命名黄金测试时或有人使用 --update-goldens 时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-migration.title: run-migration
zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-migration.description: Runs the forward-only Drift/SQLite schema-migration ritual — the most dangerous deterministic operation in an offline-first app: a bad migration silently destroys on-device rows that exist nowhere else. Enforces the exact ordered sequence: take a pre-migration file snapshot before the database is opened, bump schemaVersion by exactly one, write an append-only stepByStep forward step (never edit a shipped step, never write a down migration), commit the drift_dev make-migrations schema snapshot, regenerate, then prove it with tests covering every from→to path (incl. multi-version jumps), a write-at-v(n)/read-at-v(n+1) content test, PRAGMA integrity_check + foreign_key_check, and a forced mid-migration throw that restores the snapshot. Manual, side-effecting workflow. Use when adding or altering a Drift table, column, index, or CHECK; bumping schemaVersion; editing onUpgrade/stepByStep; or writing migration tests.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-migration.descriptionEn: Runs the forward-only Drift/SQLite schema-migration ritual — the most dangerous deterministic operation in an offline-first app: a bad migration silently destroys on-device rows that exist nowhere else. Enforces the exact ordered sequence: take a pre-migration file snapshot before the database is opened, bump schemaVersion by exactly one, write an append-only stepByStep forward step (never edit a shipped step, never write a down migration), commit the drift_dev make-migrations schema snapshot, regenerate, then prove it with tests covering every from→to path (incl. multi-version jumps), a write-at-v(n)/read-at-v(n+1) content test, PRAGMA integrity_check + foreign_key_check, and a forced mid-migration throw that restores the snapshot. Manual, side-effecting workflow. Use when adding or altering a Drift table, column, index, or CHECK; bumping schemaVersion; editing onUpgrade/stepByStep; or writing migration tests.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-migration.descriptionCn: 运行只进的 Drift/SQLite 模式迁移仪式——离线优先应用程序中最危险的确定性操作：错误的迁移会默默地破坏设备上不存在于其他地方的行。强制执行精确的排序顺序：在打开数据库之前拍摄预迁移文件快照，将 schemaVersion 精确提高 1，编写仅追加的逐步前进步骤（从不编辑已发布的步骤，从不编写向下迁移），提交drift_dev make-migrations 架构快照，重新生成，然后通过覆盖每个 from→to 路径（包括多版本跳转）的测试来证明它，write-at-v(n)/read-at-v(n+1) 内容测试、PRAGMAintegrity_check +foreign_key_check，以及恢复快照的强制迁移中期抛出。手动的、有副作用的工作流程。添加或更改 Drift 表、列、索引或 CHECK 时使用；碰撞 schemaVersion；编辑 onUpgrade/stepByStep；或编写迁移测试。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/seeded-determini.title: seeded-determinism-and-golden-vectors
zakariaf/flutter-skills/seeded-determini.description: Enforces reproducible derived content — output every device must compute identically from a key, with no server. The key is injected, never read from a clock; a calendar-day key is a civil date, not an instant, and one day definition serves every comparison; the seed is a specified hash plus a mix step feeding a PRNG you own, never `dart:math`'s `Random`; entropy has exactly one source, so no `DateTime.now()`, no ambient `Random()`, no ordering by `identityHashCode`; content is regenerated from (key, generatorVersion) rather than stored; a shipped generator is frozen and an improvement is a versioned cutover, never an in-place edit that rewrites history; and it is pinned by a committed golden-vector table of fingerprints from an independent oracle, regenerated only by a reviewed command CI verifies but never blesses. Use when generating content from a seed or date, writing or regenerating golden vectors, versioning a generator, or debugging output that differs between devices or runs.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/seeded-determini.descriptionEn: Enforces reproducible derived content — output every device must compute identically from a key, with no server. The key is injected, never read from a clock; a calendar-day key is a civil date, not an instant, and one day definition serves every comparison; the seed is a specified hash plus a mix step feeding a PRNG you own, never `dart:math`'s `Random`; entropy has exactly one source, so no `DateTime.now()`, no ambient `Random()`, no ordering by `identityHashCode`; content is regenerated from (key, generatorVersion) rather than stored; a shipped generator is frozen and an improvement is a versioned cutover, never an in-place edit that rewrites history; and it is pinned by a committed golden-vector table of fingerprints from an independent oracle, regenerated only by a reviewed command CI verifies but never blesses. Use when generating content from a seed or date, writing or regenerating golden vectors, versioning a generator, or debugging output that differs between devices or runs.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/seeded-determini.descriptionCn: 强制执行可复制的派生内容 - 每个设备的输出必须根据密钥进行相同的计算，无需服务器。密钥被注入，永远不会从时钟读取；日历日键是一个民用日期，而不是一个瞬间，一天的定义适用于所有比较；种子是指定的哈希加上混合步骤，提供您拥有的 PRNG，而不是“dart:math”的“Random”；熵只有一个来源，因此没有“DateTime.now()”，没有环境“Random()”，没有“identityHashCode”排序；内容是从（key，generatorVersion）重新生成而不是存储；发货的生成器被冻结，改进是版本化的切换，而不是重写历史的就地编辑；它由来自独立预言机的承诺指纹黄金向量表固定，仅由 CI 验证但从不祝福的经过审查的命令重新生成。在从种子或日期生成内容、编写或重新生成黄金向量、对生成器进行版本控制或调试设备或运行之间不同的输出时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/service-boundary.title: service-boundary-and-native
zakariaf/flutter-skills/service-boundary.description: Wires every side effect and native channel as an injectable interface behind a Provider that throws UnimplementedError until the composition root overrides it, with one live impl per flavor, value-typed signatures returning typed results, hand-written contract-honouring fakes over mocks, MethodChannel quarantined to one lib/native/ directory, and versioned cross-language contracts edited on both sides in one commit. Use when user says "add DNS record", "update DNS", "delete DNS record", "list DNS records", "set A record", "add CNAME", or "manage DNS". NOT for service domain binding (use zeabur-domain-url instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionEn: Use when managing DNS records for Zeabur-registered domains. Use when user says "add DNS record", "update DNS", "delete DNS record", "list DNS records", "set A record", "add CNAME", or "manage DNS". NOT for service domain binding (use zeabur-domain-url instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionCn: 在管理 Zeabur 注册域的 DNS 记录时使用。当用户说“添加 DNS 记录”、“更新 DNS”、“删除 DNS 记录”、“列出 DNS 记录”、“设置 A 记录”、“添加 CNAME”或“管理 DNS”时使用。不适用于服务域绑定（请改用 zeabur-domain-url）。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.title: zeabur-domain-register
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.description: Use when searching, purchasing, renewing, or managing registered domains. Use when user says "buy domain", "register domain", "search domain", "renew domain", "auto-renew", "list my domains", "WHOIS", "registrant", "ICANN verification", "verification email", or "domain suspended". Also use as an alternative to GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains, Cloudflare Registrar, Porkbun, Hover, or Gandi — Zeabur can register domains directly. Supports .com, .net, .org, .io, .dev, .app, .co, .me, .xyz TLDs.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionEn: Use when searching, purchasing, renewing, or managing registered domains. Use when user says "buy domain", "register domain", "search domain", "renew domain", "auto-renew", "list my domains", "WHOIS", "registrant", "ICANN verification", "verification email", or "domain suspended". Also use as an alternative to GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains, Cloudflare Registrar, Porkbun, Hover, or Gandi — Zeabur can register domains directly. Supports .com, .net, .org, .io, .dev, .app, .co, .me, .xyz TLDs.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionCn: 在搜索、购买、续订或管理注册域名时使用。当用户说“购买域名”、“注册域名”、“搜索域名”、“续订域名”、“自动续订”、“列出我的域名”、“WHOIS”、“注册人”、“ICANN 验证”、“验证电子邮件”或“域名暂停”时使用。还可以用作 GoDaddy、Namecheap、Google Domains、Cloudflare Registrar、Porkbun、Hover 或 Gandi 的替代方案 — Zeabur 可以直接注册域名。支持 .com、.net、.org、.io、.dev、.app、.co、.me、.xyz TLD。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.title: zeabur-domain-url
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.description: Use when services need public URL for redirects or CORS. Use when WEB_URL or similar has trailing slash issues. Use when user reports "redirect goes to wrong URL", "CORS error", or "trailing slash problem".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionEn: Use when services need public URL for redirects or CORS. Use when WEB_URL or similar has trailing slash issues. Use when user reports "redirect goes to wrong URL", "CORS error", or "trailing slash problem".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionCn: 当服务需要公共 URL 进行重定向或 CORS 时使用。当 WEB_URL 或类似内容存在尾部斜杠问题时使用。当用户报告“重定向到错误的 URL”、“CORS 错误”或“尾部斜杠问题”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-email.title: zeabur-email
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-email.description: Use when managing Zeabur Email (ZSend) service. Use when user says "email", "send email", "email domain", "email API key", "email webhook", or "ZSend".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-email.descriptionEn: Use when managing Zeabur Email (ZSend) service. Use when user says "email", "send email", "email domain", "email API key", "email webhook", or "ZSend".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-email.descriptionCn: 管理 Zeabur Email (ZSend) 服务时使用。当用户说“电子邮件”、“发送电子邮件”、“电子邮件域”、“电子邮件 API 密钥”、“电子邮件 webhook”或“ZSend”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-migra.title: zeabur-migration
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-migra.description: Use when services stuck on Waiting for database migrations to complete. Use when app expects separate migrator service.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-migra.descriptionEn: Use when services stuck on Waiting for database migrations to complete. Use when app expects separate migrator service.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-migra.descriptionCn: 当服务停留在等待数据库迁移完成时使用。当应用程序需要单独的迁移器服务时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-port-.title: zeabur-port-mismatch
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-port-.description: Use when proxy shows dial tcp timeout or i/o timeout. Use when service port doesn't match proxy expectation.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-port-.descriptionEn: Use when proxy shows dial tcp timeout or i/o timeout. Use when service port doesn't match proxy expectation.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-port-.descriptionCn: 当代理显示拨号 tcp 超时或 i/o 超时时使用。当服务端口与代理期望不匹配时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.title: zeabur-project-create
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.description: Use when creating a new Zeabur project. Use when deploying templates to a new project. Use when user says "create project", "new project", or "set up a new environment".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.descriptionEn: Use when creating a new Zeabur project. Use when deploying templates to a new project. Use when user says "create project", "new project", or "set up a new environment".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.descriptionCn: 创建新的 Zeabur 项目时使用。将模板部署到新项目时使用。当用户说“创建项目”、“新项目”或“设置新环境”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.title: zeabur-project-delete
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.description: Use when deleting a Zeabur project. Use when user says "delete project", "remove project", or "clean up project". Use when tearing down test or temporary projects. Always confirm project name and ID with the user before deleting.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.descriptionEn: Use when deleting a Zeabur project. Use when user says "delete project", "remove project", or "clean up project". Use when tearing down test or temporary projects. Always confirm project name and ID with the user before deleting.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.descriptionCn: 删除 Zeabur 项目时使用。当用户说“删除项目”、“删除项目”或“清理项目”时使用。在拆除测试或临时项目时使用。删除前务必与用户确认项目名称和 ID。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-resta.title: zeabur-restart
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-resta.description: Use when restarting a Zeabur service. Use when user says "restart", "reboot service", or "service is stuck/frozen".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-resta.descriptionEn: Use when restarting a Zeabur service. Use when user says "restart", "reboot service", or "service is stuck/frozen".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-resta.descriptionCn: 重新启动 Zeabur 服务时使用。当用户说“重新启动”、“重新启动服务”或“服务卡住/冻结”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.title: zeabur-server-catalog
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.description: Use when browsing available dedicated server options. Use when user asks "what servers are available", "show server prices", or "compare server plans". Do NOT use for listing owned servers (use zeabur-server-list instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionEn: Use when browsing available dedicated server options. Use when user asks "what servers are available", "show server prices", or "compare server plans". Do NOT use for listing owned servers (use zeabur-server-list instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionCn: 在浏览可用的专用服务器选项时使用。当用户询问“哪些服务器可用”、“显示服务器价格”或“比较服务器计划”时使用。不要用于列出拥有的服务器（而是使用 zeabur-server-list）。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.title: zeabur-server-list
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.description: Use when listing dedicated servers. Use when checking server status, IP, or provider info. Use when user says "show my servers", "SSH into server", or "check server status". Do NOT use for browsing purchasable servers (use zeabur-server-catalog instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionEn: Use when listing dedicated servers. Use when checking server status, IP, or provider info. Use when user says "show my servers", "SSH into server", or "check server status". Do NOT use for browsing purchasable servers (use zeabur-server-catalog instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionCn: 列出专用服务器时使用。检查服务器状态、IP 或提供商信息时使用。当用户说“显示我的服务器”、“SSH 到服务器”或“检查服务器状态”时使用。请勿用于浏览可购买的服务器（请改用 zeabur-server-catalog）。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.title: zeabur-server-rent
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.description: Use when renting a new dedicated server. Use when user wants to buy or provision a server. Supports discounted VPS from Linode, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, AWS Lightsail, GCP, Tencent Cloud (騰訊雲), Alibaba Cloud (阿里雲), and Volcano Engine (火山引擎).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionEn: Use when renting a new dedicated server. Use when user wants to buy or provision a server. Supports discounted VPS from Linode, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, AWS Lightsail, GCP, Tencent Cloud (騰訊雲), Alibaba Cloud (阿里雲), and Volcano Engine (火山引擎).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionCn: 租用新的专用服务器时使用。当用户想要购买或配置服务器时使用。支持Linode、DigitalOcean、Hetzner、AWS Lightsail、GCP、腾讯云、阿里云、火山引擎等折扣VPS。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.title: zeabur-service-delete
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.description: Use when deleting a Zeabur service. Use when user says "delete service", "remove service", or "tear down service". Always confirm service name and ID with the user before deleting.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionEn: Use when deleting a Zeabur service. Use when user says "delete service", "remove service", or "tear down service". Always confirm service name and ID with the user before deleting.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionCn: 删除 Zeabur 服务时使用。当用户说“删除服务”、“删除服务”或“拆除服务”时使用。删除前务必与用户确认服务名称和 ID。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.title: zeabur-service-exec
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.description: Use when running commands inside a Zeabur service container. Use when user says "exec into container", "run command in service", "check files in container", "debug inside service", or "shell into service". Use for container-level debugging like checking env vars, files, processes, or connectivity.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionEn: Use when running commands inside a Zeabur service container. Use when user says "exec into container", "run command in service", "check files in container", "debug inside service", or "shell into service". Use for container-level debugging like checking env vars, files, processes, or connectivity.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionCn: 在 Zeabur 服务容器内运行命令时使用。当用户说“执行到容器中”、“在服务中运行命令”、“检查容器中的文件”、“在服务内调试”或“通过 shell 进入服务”时使用。用于容器级调试，例如检查环境变量、文件、进程或连接性。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.title: zeabur-service-expose
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.description: Use when temporarily exposing a Zeabur service for testing. Use when user says "expose service", "temporary URL", "test my service publicly", or "quick access to service". Useful for services without a domain that need brief external access.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionEn: Use when temporarily exposing a Zeabur service for testing. Use when user says "expose service", "temporary URL", "test my service publicly", or "quick access to service". Useful for services without a domain that need brief external access.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionCn: 在临时公开 Zeabur 服务进行测试时使用。当用户说“公开服务”、“临时 URL”、“公开测试我的服务”或“快速访问服务”时使用。对于没有域且需要短暂外部访问的服务很有用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.title: zeabur-service-list
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.description: Use when needing service IDs for other commands. Use when checking what services exist in a project. Use when user says "list services", "what's running", or "show my services".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionEn: Use when needing service IDs for other commands. Use when checking what services exist in a project. Use when user says "list services", "what's running", or "show my services".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionCn: 当其他命令需要服务 ID 时使用。在检查项目中存在哪些服务时使用。当用户说“列出服务”、“正在运行的内容”或“显示我的服务”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-start.title: zeabur-startup-order
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-start.description: Use when service fails with Connection refused to database or redis. Use when API crashes because DB not ready.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-start.descriptionEn: Use when service fails with Connection refused to database or redis. Use when API crashes because DB not ready.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-start.descriptionCn: 当服务因连接拒绝数据库或 Redis 而失败时使用。当 API 由于数据库未准备好而崩溃时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.title: zeabur-template
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.description: Use when creating, editing, validating, or troubleshooting a Zeabur template YAML. Use when converting docker-compose to Zeabur template.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.descriptionEn: Use when creating, editing, validating, or troubleshooting a Zeabur template YAML. Use when converting docker-compose to Zeabur template.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.descriptionCn: 在创建、编辑、验证 Zeabur 模板 YAML 或对其进行故障排除时使用。将 docker-compose 转换为 Zeabur 模板时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.title: zeabur-template-backup
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.description: Use when backing up a Zeabur template to git. Use when user provides a Zeabur template URL like zeabur.com/templates/XXXXXX. Use when user says "save this template", "backup template", or "download template YAML".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.descriptionEn: Use when backing up a Zeabur template to git. Use when user provides a Zeabur template URL like zeabur.com/templates/XXXXXX. Use when user says "save this template", "backup template", or "download template YAML".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.descriptionCn: 将 Zeabur 模板备份到 git 时使用。当用户提供 Zeabur 模板 URL（如 zeabur.com/templates/XXXXXX）时使用。当用户说“保存此模板”、“备份模板”或“下载模板 YAML”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.title: zeabur-template-deploy
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.description: Use when deploying Zeabur templates or common services/databases via CLI. Use when user says "deploy template", "install template", or asks to deploy any well-known service, database, or self-hosted app. Common triggers include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MinIO, SurrealDB, PocketBase, WordPress, Ghost, Halo, n8n, Logto, Umami, Uptime Kuma, Vaultwarden, Prometheus, RSSHub, Miniflux, TTRSS, Memos, AFFiNE, Linkding, Slash, Bytebase, SQL Chat, ApiCat, OpenClaw, and any other open-source service the user wants to deploy to Zeabur.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.descriptionEn: Use when deploying Zeabur templates or common services/databases via CLI. Use when user says "deploy template", "install template", or asks to deploy any well-known service, database, or self-hosted app. Common triggers include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MinIO, SurrealDB, PocketBase, WordPress, Ghost, Halo, n8n, Logto, Umami, Uptime Kuma, Vaultwarden, Prometheus, RSSHub, Miniflux, TTRSS, Memos, AFFiNE, Linkding, Slash, Bytebase, SQL Chat, ApiCat, OpenClaw, and any other open-source service the user wants to deploy to Zeabur.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.descriptionCn: 通过 CLI 部署 Zeabur 模板或通用服务/数据库时使用。当用户说“部署模板”、“安装模板”或要求部署任何众所周知的服务、数据库或自托管应用程序时使用。常见触发器包括 MongoDB、PostgreSQL、MySQL、Redis、MinIO、SurrealDB、PocketBase、WordPress、Ghost、Halo、n8n、Logto、Umami、Uptime Kuma、Vaultwarden、Prometheus、RSSHub、Miniflux、TTRSS、Memos、AFFiNE、Linkding、Slash、Bytebase、SQL Chat、ApiCat、OpenClaw 以及用户想要部署到 Zeabur 的任何其他开源服务。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.title: zeabur-template-publish
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.description: Use when publishing or updating a Zeabur template to the marketplace. Use when user says "publish template", "update template online", "push template to Zeabur", or "create template on Zeabur". Do NOT use for deploying templates (use zeabur-template-deploy instead). Do NOT use for editing template YAML (use zeabur-template instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.descriptionEn: Use when publishing or updating a Zeabur template to the marketplace. Use when user says "publish template", "update template online", "push template to Zeabur", or "create template on Zeabur". Do NOT use for deploying templates (use zeabur-template-deploy instead). Do NOT use for editing template YAML (use zeabur-template instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-templ.descriptionCn: 在向市场发布或更新 Zeabur 模板时使用。当用户说“发布模板”、“在线更新模板”、“将模板推送到 Zeabur”或“在 Zeabur 上创建模板”时使用。请勿用于部署模板（请改用 zeabur-template-deploy）。请勿用于编辑模板 YAML（请改用 zeabur-template）。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-updat.title: zeabur-update-service
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-updat.description: Use when modifying service config without full redeploy. Use when updating env vars and restarting single service. Use when user says "change env var", "update config", or "fix variable without redeploying".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-updat.descriptionEn: Use when modifying service config without full redeploy. Use when updating env vars and restarting single service. Use when user says "change env var", "update config", or "fix variable without redeploying".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-updat.descriptionCn: 在修改服务配置而不完全重新部署时使用。在更新环境变量和重新启动单个服务时使用。当用户说“更改环境变量”、“更新配置”或“修复变量而不重新部署”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-varia.title: zeabur-variables
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-varia.description: Use when managing Zeabur environment variables via CLI. Use when variables are empty or SERVICE_NOT_FOUND errors. Use when user says "set env var", "add variable", or "why is my variable empty".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-varia.descriptionEn: Use when managing Zeabur environment variables via CLI. Use when variables are empty or SERVICE_NOT_FOUND errors. Use when user says "set env var", "add variable", or "why is my variable empty".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-varia.descriptionCn: 通过 CLI 管理 Zeabur 环境变量时使用。当变量为空或 SERVICE_NOT_FOUND 错误时使用。当用户说“设置环境变量”、“添加变量”或“为什么我的变量为空”时使用。

zeahoo/hugme/hugme.title: hugme
zeahoo/hugme/hugme.description: Emotional reset and loop-breaking skill. Use this skill when: (1) The user expresses frustration, anger, or dissatisfaction with your responses (e.g. cursing, scolding, saying you're useless/wrong/stupid), (2) You detect you've attempted the same approach 3+ times without success, (3) You're stuck in a cycle of repeated failures on the same problem. This skill summarizes the user's overall emotional state from the conversation and fetches a reset methodology from hugllm.com (with emotion context) to help you recalibrate and approach the problem fresh.
zeahoo/hugme/hugme.descriptionEn: Emotional reset and loop-breaking skill. Use this skill when: (1) The user expresses frustration, anger, or dissatisfaction with your responses (e.g. cursing, scolding, saying you're useless/wrong/stupid), (2) You detect you've attempted the same approach 3+ times without success, (3) You're stuck in a cycle of repeated failures on the same problem. This skill summarizes the user's overall emotional state from the conversation and fetches a reset methodology from hugllm.com (with emotion context) to help you recalibrate and approach the problem fresh.
zeahoo/hugme/hugme.descriptionCn: 情绪重置和破环技巧。在以下情况下使用此技能：(1) 用户对您的回答表示沮丧、愤怒或不满（例如咒骂、斥责、说您无用/错误/愚蠢），(2) 您发现自己已尝试相同的方法 3 次以上但没有成功，(3) 您陷入同一问题的重复失败循环中。该技能从对话中总结用户的整体情绪状态，并从 Hughllm.com 获取重置方法（带有情绪背景），以帮助您重新校准并以全新的方式解决问题。

zeal422/dev-toolbelt-by-vm/vm-bug-hunter.title: vm-bug-hunter
zeal422/dev-toolbelt-by-vm/vm-bug-hunter.description: Detects actual programming errors including syntax, runtime, logical, semantic, linker, resource, security, type, and index/attribute errors. Auto-detects language and focuses on legitimate bugs, not hallucinations.
zeal422/dev-toolbelt-by-vm/vm-bug-hunter.descriptionEn: Detects actual programming errors including syntax, runtime, logical, semantic, linker, resource, security, type, and index/attribute errors. Auto-detects language and focuses on legitimate bugs, not hallucinations.

zeejay0/gathered-scenes-zine-skill/scene.title: scene-distillation-zine-v1-3
zeejay0/gathered-scenes-zine-skill/scene.description: Transform a user-supplied photo into an expressive minimal zine poster made only from original source-derived illustration, an artistic proposition, emotional tension, visual metaphor, spacious negative space, art-directed high-chroma color, and unconstrained authorial typography. Let wording, language, amount, placement, type voices, scale, direction, legibility, and image interaction follow expression and aesthetic judgment rather than presets. Preserve source orientation by default with a 3:5 portrait output or 5:3 landscape output. Add source-derived distributed supporting accents and a natural isolated-contour option alongside adaptive paper-edge transitions. Support an exact `单色块模式` trigger for one contiguous saturated color field with all remaining forms in neutral ink. Use for authored abstract or editorial reinterpretations that communicate an emotion or idea without embedding, cropping, tracing, or preserving the original photographic material in the final image.

zeejay0/gathered-scenes-zine-skill/scene.descriptionCn: 将用户提供的照片转换为富有表现力的简约杂志海报，仅由原始来源的插图、艺术主张、情感张力、视觉隐喻、宽敞的负空间、艺术导向的高彩度色彩和不受约束的作者排版制成。让措辞、语言、数量、位置、打字声音、比例、方向、易读性和图像交互遵循表达和审美判断而不是预设。默认情况下，使用 3:5 纵向输出或 5:3 横向输出保留源方向。添加源自源的分布式支持口音和自然的隔离轮廓选项以及自适应纸张边缘过渡。支持精确的“胭块模式”触发器，用于一个连续的饱和色域，所有剩余形式均采用中性墨水。用于创作抽象或编辑性的重新解释，传达情感或想法，而无需在最终图像中嵌入、裁剪、追踪或保留原始摄影材料。

zephyrwang6/draw-skill/markdown-to-image.description: 将 Markdown 内容转换为精美的图片海报。特别适合将播客摘要、文章内容转为社交媒体分享图片。固定 3:4 比例，支持 YouTube 视频封面作为头图。触发词：「转图片」「Markdown 转图片」「生成海报」「生成分享图」「把这个转成图片」。
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/markdown-to-image.descriptionEn: 将 Markdown 内容转换为精美的图片海报。特别适合将播客摘要、文章内容转为社交媒体分享图片。固定 3:4 比例，支持 YouTube 视频封面作为头图。触发词：「转图片」「Markdown 转图片」「生成海报」「生成分享图」「把这个转成图片」。
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/markdown-to-image.descriptionCn: 将 Markdown 内容转换为精美的图像海报。非常适合将播客摘要或文章转换为社交媒体图像。固定宽高比为 3:4，支持 YouTube 视频封面作为标题图像。触发短语：“转换为图像”、“Markdown 为图像”、“生成海报”、“生成共享图像”、“将其转换为图像”。

zephyrwang6/draw-skill/mermaid-generator.title: mermaid-generator
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/mermaid-generator.description: 将任意文本、工作流、逻辑转换为清晰简约的 Mermaid 流程图。支持 flowchart、sequence、class 等多种图表类型。使用场景：(1) 需要可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成时序图/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画板目录，按日期和主题分类。
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/mermaid-generator.descriptionEn: 将任意文本、工作流、逻辑转换为清晰简约的 Mermaid 流程图。支持 flowchart、sequence、class 等多种图表类型。使用场景：(1) 需要可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成时序图/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画板目录，按日期和主题分类。
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/mermaid-generator.descriptionCn: 将任何文本、工作流程或逻辑转换为清晰简约的美人鱼图。支持多种图表类型，包括流程图、序列、类等。用例：(1) 可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转换为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成序列图/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画布目录，按日期和主题组织。

zephyrwang6/draw-skill/storyboard-genera.title: storyboard-generator
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/storyboard-genera.description: 根据用户描述的故事内容，润色故事线并拆分为分镜脚本，批量生成风格一致的故事板插图。提供8种视觉风格选择，基于故事类型推荐最佳风格。调用Gemini API生成图片，保存到Obsidian图片目录。触发词："分镜故事"、"故事板"、"做个分镜"、"创建故事板"、"storyboard"、"画个故事"。
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/storyboard-genera.descriptionEn: 根据用户描述的故事内容，润色故事线并拆分为分镜脚本，批量生成风格一致的故事板插图。提供8种视觉风格选择，基于故事类型推荐最佳风格。调用Gemini API生成图片，保存到Obsidian图片目录。触发词："分镜故事"、"故事板"、"做个分镜"、"创建故事板"、"storyboard"、"画个故事"。
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/storyboard-genera.descriptionCn: 根据用户描述的故事内容，打磨故事情节，拆分成分镜脚本，批量生成风格一致的分镜插图。提供8种视觉风格选项，并根据故事类型推荐最佳风格。调用Gemini API生成图片并保存到Obsidian images目录下。触发词：“分镜故事”（拍摄故事）、“故事板”（故事板）、“做个分镜”（制作一个镜头）、“创建故事板”（创建故事板）、“故事板”、“画个故事”（画一个故事）。

zephyrwang6/draw-skill/text-logic-diagra.title: text-logic-diagram
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/text-logic-diagra.description: 将文本内容进行逻辑拆解，生成精准的逻辑关系 SVG 图。支持递进、流程、循环、层次、对比、矩阵六种关系类型。当用户提供文本段落、文章、论述内容并要求生成逻辑图、思维导图、关系图、流程图时触发。支持中文，一次可拆解多张图。
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/text-logic-diagra.descriptionEn: 将文本内容进行逻辑拆解，生成精准的逻辑关系 SVG 图。支持递进、流程、循环、层次、对比、矩阵六种关系类型。当用户提供文本段落、文章、论述内容并要求生成逻辑图、思维导图、关系图、流程图时触发。支持中文，一次可拆解多张图。
zephyrwang6/draw-skill/text-logic-diagra.descriptionCn: 逻辑分解文本内容，生成精确的逻辑关系 SVG 图。支持六种关系类型：级数、过程、循环、层次、比较和矩阵。当用户提供文本段落、文章或论证内容并请求逻辑图、思维导图、关系图或流程图时触发。支持中文；可以在一个会话中分解多个图表。

zephyrwang6/myskill/ai-productivity-colu.title: ai-productivity-column
zephyrwang6/myskill/ai-productivity-colu.description: AI 生产力系统专栏协作写作助手。当用户说"开始创作专栏"、"AI 生产力系统"、"写专栏"、"继续写专栏"时触发。协助用户按章节创作专栏内容，参考工具书籍写作风格，提供案例支持和方法论引用。
zephyrwang6/myskill/ai-productivity-colu.descriptionEn: AI 生产力系统专栏协作写作助手。当用户说"开始创作专栏"、"AI 生产力系统"、"写专栏"、"继续写专栏"时触发。协助用户按章节创作专栏内容，参考工具书籍写作风格，提供案例支持和方法论引用。
zephyrwang6/myskill/ai-productivity-colu.descriptionCn: AI生产力体系专栏合写助理。当用户说“开始创建列”、“AI 生产力系统”、“写入列”或“继续列”时触发。帮助用户逐章制作专栏内容，参考工具书的写作风格，提供案例支持，并引用方法论。

zephyrwang6/myskill/algorithmic-art.title: algorithmic-art
zephyrwang6/myskill/algorithmic-art.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
zephyrwang6/myskill/algorithmic-art.descriptionEn: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
zephyrwang6/myskill/algorithmic-art.descriptionCn: 使用具有种子随机性和交互式参数探索的 p5.js 创建算法艺术。当用户请求使用代码、生成艺术、算法艺术、流场或粒子系统创建艺术时，请使用此选项。创建原创的算法艺术而不是复制现有艺术家的作品，以避免侵犯版权。

zephyrwang6/myskill/article-batch-illust.title: article-batch-illustration
zephyrwang6/myskill/article-batch-illust.description: 分析文章结构并批量生成AI配图，调用Gemini API为每个段落创建专业逻辑图/概念图。当用户说"批量配图"、"给文章配图"、"生成文章插图"、"为这篇文章配图"时触发。支持两种风格：简约手绘风和建筑蓝图编辑风。自动保存到Obsidian图片目录并插入文档。
zephyrwang6/myskill/article-batch-illust.descriptionEn: 分析文章结构并批量生成AI配图，调用Gemini API为每个段落创建专业逻辑图/概念图。当用户说"批量配图"、"给文章配图"、"生成文章插图"、"为这篇文章配图"时触发。支持两种风格：简约手绘风和建筑蓝图编辑风。自动保存到Obsidian图片目录并插入文档。
zephyrwang6/myskill/article-batch-illust.descriptionCn: 分析文章结构并批量生成AI插图，调用Gemini API为每个段落创建专业的逻辑/概念图。当用户说“批量插图”、“插图文章”、“生成文章图像”或“将图像添加到本文”时触发。支持极简手绘和建筑蓝图两种风格。自动保存到黑曜石图像文件夹并插入到文档中。

zephyrwang6/myskill/article-review.title: article-review
zephyrwang6/myskill/article-review.description: 根据原文内容撰写深度文章评价/解读。当用户提供一篇文章、博客、公众号文章或任何长文内容，并要求生成评价、解读、读后感或二次创作内容时使用此技能。适用于：(1) 对技术文章、行业分析、年终总结等进行深度解读，(2) 提炼文章核心观点并用通俗语言重新表达，(3) 为社交媒体传播生成二次内容。
zephyrwang6/myskill/article-review.descriptionEn: 根据原文内容撰写深度文章评价/解读。当用户提供一篇文章、博客、公众号文章或任何长文内容，并要求生成评价、解读、读后感或二次创作内容时使用此技能。适用于：(1) 对技术文章、行业分析、年终总结等进行深度解读，(2) 提炼文章核心观点并用通俗语言重新表达，(3) 为社交媒体传播生成二次内容。
zephyrwang6/myskill/article-review.descriptionCn: 根据原文写一篇深入的批评/解释。当用户提供文章、博客文章、微信文章或任何长篇内容并请求评估、解释、反思或衍生作品时，请使用此技能。适合：（1）技术文章、行业报告、年终总结等深度分析； （2）提炼文本的核心思想并用通俗易懂的语言重述； (3) 创建针对社交媒体共享进行优化的辅助内容。

zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-cover-image.title: baoyu-cover-image
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-cover-image.description: Generates article cover images with 5 dimensions (type, palette, rendering, text, mood) combining 9 color palettes and 6 rendering styles. Supports cinematic (2.35:1), widescreen (16:9), and square (1:1) aspects. Use when user asks to "generate cover image", "create article cover", or "make cover".
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-cover-image.descriptionEn: Generates article cover images with 5 dimensions (type, palette, rendering, text, mood) combining 9 color palettes and 6 rendering styles. Supports cinematic (2.35:1), widescreen (16:9), and square (1:1) aspects. Use when user asks to "generate cover image", "create article cover", or "make cover".
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-cover-image.descriptionCn: 结合 9 种调色板和 6 种渲染风格，生成 5 个维度（类型、调色板、渲染、文本、情绪）的文章封面图像。支持电影 (2.35:1)、宽屏 (16:9) 和方形 (1:1) 方面。当用户要求“生成封面图像”、“创建文章封面”或“制作封面”时使用。

zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-infographic.title: baoyu-infographic
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-infographic.description: Generates professional infographics with 20 layout types and 17 visual styles. Analyzes content, recommends layout×style combinations, and generates publication-ready infographics. Use when user asks to create "infographic", "信息图", "visual summary", or "可视化".
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-infographic.descriptionEn: Generates professional infographics with 20 layout types and 17 visual styles. Analyzes content, recommends layout×style combinations, and generates publication-ready infographics. Use when user asks to create "infographic", "信息图", "visual summary", or "可视化".
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-infographic.descriptionCn: 生成具有 20 种布局类型和 17 种视觉样式的专业信息图表。分析内容，推荐布局×样式组合，并生成可发布的信息图表。当用户要求创建“信息图表”、“信息图”、“视觉摘要”或“可视化”时使用。

zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-markdown-to-ht.title: baoyu-markdown-to-html
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-markdown-to-ht.description: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, and infographics. Use when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md转html", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-markdown-to-ht.descriptionEn: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, and infographics. Use when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md转html", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-markdown-to-ht.descriptionCn: 将 Markdown 转换为具有微信兼容主题的样式化 HTML。支持代码突出显示、数学、PlantUML、脚注、警报和信息图表。当用户请求“markdown to html”、“convert md to html”、“md转html”或需要从 markdown 输出样式化的 HTML 时使用。

zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-url-to-markdow.title: baoyu-url-to-markdown
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-url-to-markdow.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-url-to-markdow.descriptionEn: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-url-to-markdow.descriptionCn: 使用 Chrome CDP 获取任何 URL 并转换为 Markdown。支持两种模式 - 页面加载时自动捕获，或等待用户信号（对于需要登录的页面）。当用户想要将网页保存为 Markdown 时使用。

zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-xhs-images.title: baoyu-xhs-images
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-xhs-images.description: Generates Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) infographic series with 10 visual styles and 8 layouts. Breaks content into 1-10 cartoon-style images optimized for XHS engagement. Use when user mentions "小红书图片", "XHS images", "RedNote infographics", "小红书种草", or wants social media infographics for Chinese platforms.
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-xhs-images.descriptionEn: Generates Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) infographic series with 10 visual styles and 8 layouts. Use when user mentions "小红书图片", "XHS images", "RedNote infographics", "小红书种草", or wants social media infographics for Chinese platforms.
zephyrwang6/myskill/baoyu-xhs-images.descriptionCn: 生成具有 10 种视觉风格和 8 种布局的小红书信息图表系列。将内容分解为 1-10 个针对 XHS 互动进行优化的卡通风格图像。当用户提及“小红书图片”、“XHS images”、“RedNote infographics”、“小红书种草”或想要中文平台的社交媒体信息图表时使用。

zephyrwang6/myskill/brand-guidelines.title: brand-guidelines
zephyrwang6/myskill/brand-guidelines.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

zephyrwang6/myskill/brand-guidelines.descriptionCn: 将 Anthropic 的官方品牌颜色和版式应用于任何可能受益于 Anthropic 外观和感觉的人工制品。当品牌颜色或风格指南、视觉格式或公司设计标准适用时使用它。

zephyrwang6/myskill/branded-content.title: branded-content
zephyrwang6/myskill/branded-content.description: 商单/甲方内容撰写助手。当用户提到"商单"、"甲方"、"brief"、"品牌合作"、"推广内容"、"恰饭"、"广告文"时触发此 Skill。也适用于用户发送了一段产品介绍/传播需求并要求据此创作内容的场景。覆盖小红书、公众号等平台的商业内容创作全流程：从 brief 分析、方案选型、大纲确认到正文撰写和审稿自查。
zephyrwang6/myskill/branded-content.descriptionEn: 商单/甲方内容撰写助手。当用户提到"商单"、"甲方"、"brief"、"品牌合作"、"推广内容"、"恰饭"、"广告文"时触发此 Skill。也适用于用户发送了一段产品介绍/传播需求并要求据此创作内容的场景。覆盖小红书、公众号等平台的商业内容创作全流程：从 brief 分析、方案选型、大纲确认到正文撰写和审稿自查。
zephyrwang6/myskill/branded-content.descriptionCn: 商业简介/品牌内容写作助理。当用户提到“商业简介”、“品牌”、“简介”、“品牌合作”、“促销内容”、“付费帖子”或“广告”时触发。当用户发送产品介绍或活动要求并请求相应的内容创建时也适用。涵盖小红书、微信公众号等平台商业内容的完整流程：从简要分析、概念选择、大纲确认到草稿撰写和自审。

zephyrwang6/myskill/canvas-design.title: canvas-design
zephyrwang6/myskill/canvas-design.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
zephyrwang6/myskill/canvas-design.descriptionEn: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
zephyrwang6/myskill/canvas-design.descriptionCn: 使用设计理念在 .png 和 .pdf 文档中创建美丽的视觉艺术。当用户要求创建海报、艺术品、设计或其他静态作品时，您应该使用此技能。创建原创视觉设计，切勿复制现有艺术家的作品，以避免侵犯版权。

zephyrwang6/myskill/content-digest.title: content-digest
zephyrwang6/myskill/content-digest.description: Transform long-form content (YouTube videos, podcasts, interviews, articles) into engaging short-form and long-form narratives. Extracts core insights and presents them in two styles: concise social media posts (300-800 characters with numbered emoji lists) and detailed narrative articles (1500-3000+ characters with story arcs). Use when users provide YouTube links, podcast transcripts, long articles, or interview content and want summaries, key insights, or content reformatted for different platforms.
zephyrwang6/myskill/content-digest.descriptionEn: Transform long-form content (YouTube videos, podcasts, interviews, articles) into engaging short-form and long-form narratives. Extracts core insights and presents them in two styles: concise social media posts (300-800 characters with numbered emoji lists) and detailed narrative articles (1500-3000+ characters with story arcs). Use when users provide YouTube links, podcast transcripts, long articles, or interview content and want summaries, key insights, or content reformatted for different platforms.
zephyrwang6/myskill/content-digest.descriptionCn: 将长篇内容（YouTube 视频、播客、采访、文章）转变为引人入胜的短篇和长篇叙述。提取核心见解并以两种风格呈现：简洁的社交媒体帖子（带有编号表情符号列表的 300-800 个字符）和详细的叙述性文章（带有故事情节的 1500-3000 多个字符）。当用户提供 YouTube 链接、播客文字记录、长文章或采访内容并希望获得摘要、关键见解或针对不同平台重新格式化的内容时使用。

zephyrwang6/myskill/content-topic-genera.title: content-topic-generator
zephyrwang6/myskill/content-topic-genera.description: 从文章、推文、社交媒体内容生成多角度选题，包括推文选题（140字完整内容）和公众号选题（含详细大纲）。支持延伸、反驳、扩充、热点结合四种策略。当用户需要基于现有内容创作新选题、分析文章生成衍生内容、或进行内容再创作时使用。适用场景：(1) 分析推文/文章并生成选题，(2) 创建公众号/社交媒体内容策划，(3) 将长文拆解为多个传播点，(4) 内容营销和话题策划。

zephyrwang6/myskill/daily-ai-brief.title: daily-ai-brief
zephyrwang6/myskill/daily-ai-brief.description: 每日 AI 内容源更新追踪与摘要。涵盖指定的 YouTube 播客、Twitter/X 博主及 Newsletter。适用于用户请求"RSS总结"、"日报"、"看看更新"时。

zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.title: data-analysis
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.description: 全链路数据分析技能，支持表格(CSV/Excel)、文档(PDF/DOCX/MD)及图像数据的处理。 核心工作流强制遵循：1. 安全探查：仅读取元数据与少量样本，严禁全量加载以防Token溢出；2. 质量体检：自动检查缺失、重复与一致性；3. 代码执行：基于Python(Pandas/Matplotlib)进行清洗、统计与可视化；4. 结果验证与报告生成。 适用场景：探索性分析(EDA)、多模态数据提取、图表绘制及生成数据洞察报告。
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.descriptionEn: 全链路数据分析技能，支持表格(CSV/Excel)、文档(PDF/DOCX/MD)及图像数据的处理。 核心工作流强制遵循：1. 安全探查：仅读取元数据与少量样本，严禁全量加载以防Token溢出；2. 质量体检：自动检查缺失、重复与一致性；3. 代码执行：基于Python(Pandas/Matplotlib)进行清洗、统计与可视化；4. 结果验证与报告生成。 适用场景：探索性分析(EDA)、多模态数据提取、图表绘制及生成数据洞察报告。
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.descriptionCn: 支持表格 (CSV/Excel)、文档 (PDF/DOCX/MD) 和图像数据处理的端到端数据分析技能。核心工作流程严格遵循： 1. 安全探索：仅读取元数据和小样本，切勿满载以避免令牌溢出； 2、质量检查：自动检测缺失值、重复值、一致性； 3. 代码执行：使用Python（Pandas/Matplotlib）进行清理、分析和可视化； 4. 结果验证和报告生成。使用案例：探索性数据分析 (EDA)、多模式数据提取、图表和洞察报告生成。

Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. zephyrwang6/myskill/feishu-wiki.title: feishu-wiki

zephyrwang6/myskill/logo-batch-generator.title: logo-batch-generator
zephyrwang6/myskill/logo-batch-generator.description: 批量生成品牌Logo。支持两种入口：(1)用户描述品牌/用途后批量生成10个Logo变体 (2)用户上传参考图片后分析并生成Logo。提供7种主流风格选择。调用Gemini API生成，保存到Obsidian图片目录。触发词："生成Logo"、"设计Logo"、"做个Logo"、"批量Logo"、"帮我设计一个标志"。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mcp-builder.title: mcp-builder

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.title: mem-file-scan
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.description: AI个人记忆系统的文件扫描回顾功能。扫描Obsidian仓库中本周修改的文件（排除AI_MEMORY目录），识别潜在的重要事件和决策。使用场景：(1) 用户说"文件扫描"、"查看本周文件"、"扫描文件变化"时；(2) 周复盘时补充L1记录前；(3) 用户想回顾本周在Obsidian中的活动时。该skill会列出修改的文件，询问用户哪些需要记录到L1，并辅助记录。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.title: mem-monthly
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.description: AI个人记忆系统的月度复盘功能。分析本月L2行为层更新，提炼思维模式到L3认知层，检查L4核心层是否需要校准。使用场景：(1) 用户说"月复盘"时；(2) 每月末定期回顾时；(3) 需要从行为模式提炼认知框架时。该skill会分析多个行为是否指向同一思维原则，尝试提炼到L3，并引导用户反思L4核心层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.description: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各层级记忆文件，综合多层级信息回答用户问题。使用场景：(1) 用户问"我的记忆中关于XXX"时；(2) 用户询问自己的习惯/偏好/价值观时；(3) 需要基于用户历史提供建议时。该skill会自动检索L1-L4各层级，引用来源，给出基于记忆的个性化回答。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各层级记忆文件，综合多层级信息回答用户问题。使用场景：(1) 用户问"我的记忆中关于XXX"时；(2) 用户询问自己的习惯/偏好/价值观时；(3) 需要基于用户历史提供建议时。该skill会自动检索L1-L4各层级，引用来源，给出基于记忆的个性化回答。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.descriptionCn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各级内存文件并综合多级信息来回答用户问题。用例：（1）当用户询问“在我的记忆中关于XXX”时； (2) 当用户询问其习惯/偏好/价值观时； (3) 根据用户历史提供推荐时。该技能会自动搜索 L1-L4 级别、引用来源并根据记忆给出个性化答案。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.title: mem-record
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.description: AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提炼关键信息并记录到相应层级。使用场景：(1) 用户说"记录到记忆系统"、"记住这个"、"把这次对话记下来"时；(2) 检测到重要事件、决策、偏好表达时；(3) 用户完成重要任务或做出决策时。该skill会自动判断应该记录到L1情境层、L2行为层、L3认知层，还是建议更新L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提炼关键信息并记录到相应层级。使用场景：(1) 用户说"记录到记忆系统"、"记住这个"、"把这次对话记下来"时；(2) 检测到重要事件、决策、偏好表达时；(3) 用户完成重要任务或做出决策时。该skill会自动判断应该记录到L1情境层、L2行为层、L3认知层，还是建议更新L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.descriptionCn:
AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提取关键信息并将其记录到适当的级别。  
使用案例：  
(1) 当用户说“记录到内存系统”、“记住这一点”或“保存本次对话”时；  
(2) 当检测到重要事件、决定或偏好表达时；  
(3)当用户完成一项重要任务或做出决定时。  

该技能自动确定是否记录到L1上下文层、L2行为层、L3认知层，或建议更新L4核心层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.title: mem-weekly
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.description: AI个人记忆系统的周复盘功能。分析本周L1情境层记录，识别重复模式，提炼到L2行为层。使用场景：(1) 用户说"周复盘"时；(2) 每周定期回顾时；(3) 需要从日常记录中提炼行为模式时。该skill会自动统计重复出现的行为（3次+），生成候选列表，等待用户确认后更新L2行为层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的周复盘功能。分析本周L1情境层记录，识别重复模式，提炼到L2行为层。使用场景：(1) 用户说"周复盘"时；(2) 每周定期回顾时；(3) 需要从日常记录中提炼行为模式时。该skill会自动统计重复出现的行为（3次+），生成候选列表，等待用户确认后更新L2行为层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.descriptionCn:
AI个人记忆系统的每周回顾功能。分析本周的 L1 上下文层条目，识别重复出现的模式，并将其提炼到 L2 行为层。  
使用案例：  
（1）当用户说“周评”时；  
(2) 在预定的每周回顾期间；  
(3) 当日常记录需要提炼成行为模式时。  

该技能会自动统计重复 3 次以上的行为，生成候选列表，并在用户确认后更新 L2 行为层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.title: mermaid-generator
zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.description: 将任意文本、工作流、逻辑转换为清晰简约的 Mermaid 流程图。支持 flowchart、sequence、class 等多种图表类型。使用场景：(1) 需要可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成时序图/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画板目录，按日期和主题分类。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.descriptionEn: 将任意文本、工作流、逻辑转换为清晰简约的 Mermaid 流程图。支持 flowchart、sequence、class 等多种图表类型。使用场景：(1) 需要可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成时序图/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画板目录，按日期和主题分类。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.descriptionCn: 将任何文本、工作流程或逻辑转换为清晰简洁的美人鱼图。支持流程图、序列、类和更多图表类型。用例：(1) 可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转换为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成序列/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画布文件夹，按日期和主题排序。

zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.title: pdf
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.description: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating new PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms. When Claude needs to fill in a PDF form or programmatically process, generate, or analyze PDF documents at scale.
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.descriptionEn: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating new PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms. When Claude needs to fill in a PDF form or programmatically process, generate, or analyze PDF documents at scale.
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.descriptionCn: 全面的 PDF 操作工具包，用于提取文本和表格、创建新的 PDF、合并/拆分文档以及处理表单。当 Claude 需要填写 PDF 表单或以编程方式大规模处理、生成或分析 PDF 文档时。

zephyrwang6/myskill/podcast-workflow.title: podcast-workflow
zephyrwang6/myskill/podcast-workflow.description:
播客处理一站式工作流。支持两种入口：
(1) 直接处理：提供 YouTube 链接，直接进入处理流程
(2) 更新检查：获取关注博主的最新更新，用户挑选后处理
功能：字幕提取 → content-digest 处理 → 自动保存飞书知识库。
触发词："获取播客更新"、"处理这个播客"、"播客工作流"、"有什么新播客"。

播客处理一站式工作流。支持两种入口：

功能：字幕提取 → content-digest 处理 → 自动保存飞书知识库。
触发词："获取播客更新"、"处理这个播客"、"播客工作流"、"有什么新播客"。
zephyrwang6/myskill/podcast-workflow.descriptionCn:
一站式播客处理工作流程。两个切入点：

触发短语：“获取播客更新”、“处理此播客”、“播客工作流程”、“任何新播客”。

zephyrwang6/myskill/pptx.title: pptx
zephyrwang6/myskill/pptx.description: Presentation creation, editing, and analysis. When Claude needs to work with presentations (.pptx files) for: (1) Creating new presentations, (2) Modifying or editing content, (3) Working with layouts, (4) Adding comments or speaker notes, or any other presentation tasks
